scripts.text: - Cannot progress quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由於你持有的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Commander Arquien]
Huh? I don't know who you are but don't come in here without permission.
I would like it if you left immediately.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 阿爾奎恩]
嗯？我不知道你是誰，但沒有許可不要進來。
請立刻離開。

scripts.text:
[Commander Arquien]
Oh, you're that famous {0}?
I should offer you some tea or something but I don't have any tea.
Sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 阿爾奎恩]
哦，你是那位著名的{0}？
我想請你喝點茶什麼的，但我沒有茶。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Commander Arquien]
I will introduce myself first. I am the founder of the Eden Group and its Commander Arquien Nile Atnad.
My name is complicated so you can just call me Nile.
scripts.translation:
[指揮官 阿爾奎恩]
讓我先自我介紹。我是樂園團的創始人，指揮官阿爾奎恩·尼羅·阿特納德。
我的名字很複雜，你可以直接叫我尼羅。

scripts.text: What brings you to see me?
scripts.translation: 什麼事讓你來見我？

scripts.text: Your middle name?
scripts.translation: 你的中間名？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Huh, right to the point?
I welcome it.
You know what is the biggest rumor going around town these days?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
嗯，直入主題？
我歡迎。
你知道最近城裡流傳最大的謠言是什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
It's childhood name my mother gave me when I was young..
It feels better to hear than the name given to me by my damn father, okay?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
那是我母親在我小時候給我起的乳名...
比起我那個該死的父親給我起的名字，聽起來好多了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Instead of being entertained by other people's personal life, why don't you focus on something else?
They are talking about it a lot these days.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
與其關注別人的私生活，不如關注點別的？
最近大家都在談論這個。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Right. About the extended excavation of Juperos.
They already excavated as much as they could..
Hasn't it been awhile since people have been turning it over claiming it as some kind of unknown mechanical civilization, a product of scientific power?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
對。關於朱佩羅斯的擴充套件挖掘。
他們已經挖掘了能挖的部分...
自從人們把它翻來覆去地當作某種未知的機械文明、科學力量的產物以來，已經過了一段時間了吧？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
So.. Why are they promoting and recruiting for the excavation now?
Didn't you see the recruitment notice posted on the squad office?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
那麼... 為什麼現在又在宣傳和招募挖掘人員？
你沒看到小隊辦公室貼的招募告示嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
First this is the information we have.
A new passage is discovered in the Juperos area.
So we thought it was another area of Juperos...
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
首先，這是我們要掌握的資訊。
在朱佩羅斯地區發現了一條新的通道。
所以我們以為那是朱佩羅斯的另一個區域...

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Surprisingly the newly discovered area is connected to Juperos but it is another site with a different form.
This excavation's goal is that newly discovered area.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
令人驚訝的是，新發現的區域與朱佩羅斯相連，但它是一個形式不同的另一個地點。
這次挖掘的目標就是那個新發現的區域。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
What.. was.. the name. Ah.. I don't know.
It is commonly being referred to as the 'Phantasmagorika' plan.
Rekenber of Lighthalzen is the sponsor of the excavation recruitment and support.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
那個... 叫什麼名字。啊... 我不知道。
它通常被稱為“幻影魔境”計劃。
裡希塔樂鎮的雷肯貝爾是挖掘招募和支援的贊助人。

scripts.text: So?
scripts.translation: 然後呢？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Huh? Not that interesting?
Should I stop here?
I was prepared because Rahim recommended you.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
嗯？不感興趣？
我該停在這裡嗎？
因為拉希姆推薦了你，所以我做了準備。

scripts.text: Please continue.
scripts.translation: 請繼續。

scripts.text: Please stop.
scripts.translation: 請停下。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Well, I'm not interested in telling more to somebody who's not interested either.
You're not the only one registered with the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
好吧，我對一個不感興趣的人也沒興趣說更多。
你不是唯一在樂園團登記的人。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I should ask Rahim to recommend me someone else.
I get it so go on along now.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
我應該讓拉希姆給我推薦別人。
我明白了，現在走吧。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Sure. We also wanted to participate in the Phantasmagorika.
Of course under the name of Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
當然。我們也想參與幻影魔境。
當然，是以樂園團的名義。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
... What, you're interested again now?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
... 什麼，你現在又感興趣了？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
As you wish.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
如你所願。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Should I continue talking?
We also wanted to participate in the Phantasmagorika.
Of course under the name of Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
還要繼續說嗎？
我們也想參與幻影魔境。
當然，是以樂園團的名義。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Although we operated mostly as a broker between clients and implementers
we can't be stuck with Morocc forever.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
雖然我們主要充當客戶與執行者之間的中介，
但我們不能永遠被摩洛哥束縛住。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Rahim argued that we can advance further by using this as an opportunity.
Through this work we have during that time become acquainted and networked with many adventurers and strong warriors like you..
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
拉希姆認為，我們可以利用這個機會更進一步。
通過這項工作，我們在那段時間裡結識了許多冒險者，以及像您這樣強大的戰士，建立了人脈。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I'm saying we want to use your manpower. Aren't we pros at introducing human resources? Ahahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
我的意思是，我們想利用你們的人力。我們不是最擅長介紹人力資源的嗎？啊哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Truthfully the infamously haughty Rekenber requested us.
They are in need to a lot of manpower so they need us to broker.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
說實話，是那些臭名昭著、傲慢的雷肯貝爾找上了我們。
他們急需大量人力，所以需要我們來做中介。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Not a bad proposition. Honestly it's a good opportunity.
We introduce people and get paid, you work and get paid.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
這提議不錯。老實說，這是個很好的機會。
我們介紹人並收取費用，你們工作並獲得報酬。

scripts.text: Wanting to participate in Phantasmagorika?
scripts.translation: 想要參與幻影魔境？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
It can be summarized as such.
Basically you're participating in the site excavation work but
you can help with a personal favor as well.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
可以這樣概括。
基本上你是參與現場挖掘工作，
但也可以順便幫個私人忙。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
If you participate in the excavation team can you confirm something for me?
You will hear more details from Rahim..
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
如果你加入挖掘團隊，能幫我確認一件事嗎？
更多細節你可以從拉希姆那裡聽到。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I want one thing.
There are several excavation teams and organizations currently participating in the Phantasmagorika excavation.
I would like you to work in an excavation team Rahim introduces.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
我有一件事。
目前有幾個挖掘團隊和組織正在參與幻影魔境的挖掘。
我希望你加入拉希姆介紹的那個挖掘團隊。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
And, as your working with the excavation team ^4d4dffask about the Last Exploration^000000.
Rahim will give you the details.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
而且，當你與挖掘團隊一起工作時，^4d4dff調查一下“最後的探索”^000000。
拉希姆會給你詳細說明。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
It's the next room so you can get the details there.
Also, if you find out anything let me know. You don't need to tell anybody else.
Come right back here. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
就在隔壁房間，你可以去那裡瞭解詳情。
另外，如果你發現任何情況，告訴我。不需要告訴其他人。
直接回到這裡來。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Rahim is waiting in the next room.
He is the one who started this work first so get the details from him.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
拉希姆在隔壁房間等著。
他是這項工作的發起人，所以從他那裡獲取細節。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Hey, are you beginning in earnest now?
Then what are you doing here? Run off now!
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
嘿，你是真的要開始行動了嗎？
那你在這裡幹什麼？現在就走！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Run off and look at that stuck-up doctor for me.
Ah....He's not starving and being weak is he? Huh?
Observe and tell me.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
快跑，替我看看那個傲慢的醫生。
啊……他沒有捱餓，也沒有變弱吧？嗯？
觀察一下，然後告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Now-! Go now!
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
現在-！快走！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
How is work on the excavation team?
..Rahim is doing well right?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
挖掘團隊的工作怎麼樣？
……拉希姆還好吧？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
... The old man. He's doing well? What? Is he? Maybe it's funny and childish to be like this at this point.
Darn! I don't know. Get out!
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
……那個老人。他好嗎？什麼？是嗎？也許到了這個時候還這樣想有點可笑和幼稚。
該死！我不知道。滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Huh? What's going on?
If it's about reports, I am getting them through Luke.
I heard you are working pretty hard?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
嗯？怎麼回事？
如果是關於報告的事，我是通過盧克收到的。
聽說你工作很努力？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Thanks to that your position with the Atnad excavator and Eden Group are getting better so it is great.
... It would better if it wasn't for my damn father.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
多虧了你，你在樂園團和挖掘者團隊中的地位越來越高，這很好。
……如果不是因為我那個該死的父親，情況會更好。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Anyway, why did you come?
Did you find out about the Last Exploration?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
總之，你來這裡做什麼？
你查到了關於“最後探索”的事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
He told you to being something back?
What, is that?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
他讓你帶什麼東西回來？
什麼？那是？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I am not sure what you're talking about but..
He told you to bring it back?
Why would I?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
我不確定你在說什麼，但是……
他讓你把它帶回來？
我為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Tell me exactly what it is you have to take back.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
告訴我，你具體要帶回來的是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Hum...Record Player?
He actually remembers there was something like that in the house?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
嗯……記憶音盤？
他真的記得家裡有這麼個東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I don't know how this will affect your position but...
I don't think so?
Reject!
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
我不知道這會影響你的地位，但是……
我不覺得會吧？
拒絕！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Darn it.
Okay. I got it.
I have the record player.
Give me Memory Records if you have them!
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
該死。
好吧。我知道了。
我有記憶音盤。
如果你有的話，把記憶音盤給我！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
What? No?
Well.. this is bad,
want to get a Record player.
Brings the Memory Record player!
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
什麼？沒有？
那……這就麻煩了，
想要得到記憶音盤。
把記憶音盤帶來！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Hm.. is this it?
Looks like it will fit.
You mean this came out of that place?
But this might be a bit tough.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
嗯……是這個嗎？
看起來能裝進去。
你是說這東西是從那個地方出來的？
但這可能有點棘手。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
My stupid father didn't care about the things in the house because he was too busy outside.
Can't he didn't notice something like this.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
我那個愚蠢的父親太忙了，根本不在乎家裡的東西。
他不可能注意到這種東西。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Humph. Unfortunately I think somebody took this Memory Record apart on purpose.
It won't run with just one piece.
I need at least five.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
哼。不幸的是，我覺得有人故意拆開了這個記憶音盤。
只有一片是執行不了的。
我至少需要五片。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Hm..
Okay. Then let's do this.
I will go to the excavation site with the record player.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
嗯……
好吧。那就這麼辦。
我會帶著記憶音盤去挖掘現場。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
You collect the remaining Memory Records during that time.
Somebody probably did it on purpose so pieces will be scattered around.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
在那期間，你去收集剩下的記憶音盤。
有人可能是故意拆開的，所以碎片會散落各處。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
You understood, what I said?
Then let's see each other in Verus.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
你明白我說的話了嗎？
那我們在維魯斯見。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Collect ^4d4dff5 things like memory records^000000.
They will be hidden in places around Verus somewhere, so good luck.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
收集^4d4dff5像記憶音盤這樣的東西^000000。
它們會藏在維魯斯周圍的某個地方，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
..You.. Me going to the excavation site..
Keep it a secret from my father..
..Hm..
Well, no special reason to keep it a secret.
Do as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
……你……我去挖掘現場……
對我父親保密……
……嗯……
好吧，沒有特別理由要保密。
隨你便。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
I'm not going there myself because of curiosity.
I am a busy person myself.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
我自己不會去那裡，因為好奇。
我自己也很忙。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I am sorry but you cannot enter further without approval.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
很抱歉，未經批准，您無法進入更深處。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
You are a member of the Atnad excavation team.
I will guide you inside.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾衛兵]
您是阿特納德考古隊的一員。
我會為您引路。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Sh. I'm just here as escort.
scripts.translation:
[盧克]
噓。我只是負責護衛的。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
I am the chairman of Rekenber.
I invited you to come.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾會長]
我是雷肯貝爾的會長。
是我邀請你們來的。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
I have heard a lot and am familiar with the activities of the Atnad excavation team.
A lot of big results are being achieved as a corporation.
Thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾會長]
我聽說過很多，也很熟悉阿特納德考古隊的活動。
作為公司，你們取得了很大的成果。
謝謝你們。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
The reason I have invited you....
You may already know as team leader Dr. Atnad.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾會長]
我邀請你們來的原因是……
作為隊長，您應該已經知道了，阿特納德博士。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Could it be......
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
難道說……

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
It is what you are predicting.
It's about the Memory Records contents you have been working so hard to collect.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾會長]
正是您所預料的。
關於你們辛苦收集的記憶音盤的內容。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
We plan to dispose of the content known through the Memory Records and the word of the Memory Records themselves as if it never happened.
I hope you will cooperate with this.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾會長]
我們計劃銷燬通過記憶音盤獲知的內容，以及記憶音盤本身，彷彿這一切從未發生過。
希望您能配合。

scripts.text: What did you say?
scripts.translation: 你說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
If this information is leaked outside, the corporation is willing to treat your excavation team with courtesy.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾會長]
如果這些資訊洩露出去，公司願意以禮相待，照顧你們的考古隊。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Treatment? Courtesy?
What are you trying to sell!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
照顧？以禮相待？
你們想幹什麼！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What is the reason people can't know about the past of the city buried underground!
Who are you to act like this!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
為什麼人們不能知道埋在地下的城市的歷史！
你們憑什麼這樣做！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
We are people who look to truth and fact through the past.
Are you trying to block your eyes and ears now?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我們是通過過去來追尋真相和事實的人。
你們是想掩耳盜鈴嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
Instead we will give you sole rights to everything related to the Memory Records.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
相反，我們將授予你們與記憶音盤相關的一切的獨家權利。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What are you talking about now?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你們現在又在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
We do not mean cease your work.
We are not saying discard all the information you have found.
However, what we want is...
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
我們並不是要停止你們的工作。
我們也不是說丟棄你們發現的所有資訊。
但是，我們想要的是……

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
I want to bury the story between myself, and you.
Do you not remember?
We are probably acquainted.
Although I did make some preparations.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
我想把我和你們之間的故事埋藏起來。
你不記得了嗎？
我們可能認識。
雖然我做了一些準備。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
... Now that I think you do look familiar..
Juperos!
Yes, I saw you at Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
……現在想想，你確實看起來很熟悉。
朱佩羅斯！
是的，我在朱佩羅斯見過你。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
That time you did.. in the crack that looked like a passage...
......You attacked me!
You bastard.. Because of you..!!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
那次你……在那個看起來像通道的裂縫裡……
……你襲擊了我！
你這個混蛋……因為你……！！

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Hoho. I meet the main culprit of my family's destruction.
Is this meant to be?
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
呵呵。我竟然見到了導致我家破人亡的罪魁禍首。
這就是命運嗎？

scripts.text: What do you mean family's destruction?
scripts.translation: 家破人亡是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
The time, that accident or whatever you call it.
When I found a seemingly artificial obstacle during the Juperos excavation..
Ian suddenly disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
就是那次，不管你們管它叫事故還是什麼。
在朱佩羅斯發掘時，我發現了一個看似人造的障礙物……
伊恩突然就消失了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I found myself in a motel room in Juno when I came to.
I didn't even know how much time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我醒來時發現自己躺在朱諾的一家汽車旅館裡。
我甚至不知道過了多久。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
The man went to look around the excavation site and didn't return in over a week...
What do you think we thought?
We wondered if he suffered an unfortunate accident.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
那個男人去發掘現場四處檢視，卻超過一週沒有回來……
你覺得我們會怎麼想？
我們以為他遭遇了不幸的事故。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
My teeth gnash whenever I think of that time.
Because of the vague memories of that time..
I clung to Juperos like a mad man.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
每當想起那段時光，我就咬牙切齒。
因為對那段時間模糊的記憶……
我像瘋子一樣執著於朱佩羅斯。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
......I am sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
……對此我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
You're the one who attacked me, right?
What happened to the week I lost.
...After that, I chased after an illusion I wasn't sure was a dream or hallucination.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
襲擊我的人就是你，對吧？
我失去的那一週發生了什麼。
……在那之後，我追逐著一個不知是夢還是幻覺的幻影。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I blindly went around Juperos.
Lost my team members.. even forgot that I had a family and a home to go back to.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我盲目地在朱佩羅斯遊蕩。
失去了團隊成員……甚至忘記了自己還有家人和家可以回去。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
...Why did you?
Please tell me. Chief Secretary.
Why did you attack father?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
……為什麼？
請告訴我，首席秘書。
為什麼要襲擊父親？

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
That is.. because the doctor saw something he shouldn't have at the time.
Verus city was not ready to be revealed.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
那是……因為醫生當時看到了不該看的東西。
維魯斯城還不具備被揭露的條件。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
What?! Verus!!!
So what I found then was a passage to Verus?!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
什麼？！維魯斯！！！
所以我當時發現的，是通往維魯斯的通道？！

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
No no wait wait.
Father, speak to me for a moment.
I just need a moment.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
不不，等等。
父親，請和我對話一會兒。
我只需要一點時間。

scripts.text:
I don't know what is happening.
Should we listen to the Atnads first?
scripts.translation:
我不知道發生了什麼。
我們要先聽聽阿特納德家的話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
.... What can we do.
We will wait. Please speak.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾會長]
……我們該怎麼辦呢。
我們就等著吧。請說。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Chairman]
A chairman's job is to do nothing in times like this.
... That is it.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾會長]
會長的職責，就是在這樣的時刻什麼都不做。
……就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
....
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
……

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
The chairman has waited for a long time.
I as well.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
會長已經等了很久了。
我也是。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
Are you taken aback?
So have I. I did not think people's lives to be tied together as so.
Anyway that young lady...
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
你們感到驚訝嗎？
我也一樣。我沒想到人們的命運會如此緊密相連。
總之，那位年輕女士……

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
.. has a good strong attitude.
True.
Please speak.
I will wait.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
……有著非常堅定的態度。
確實如此。
請說。
我會等著。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
I see it is my turn again.
I will formally introduce you.
The last survivor of Verus City, Tatio.W.00H-1.
Simply call him Tatio.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
看來又輪到我了。
請允許我正式介紹一下。
維魯斯城的最後倖存者，塔蒂奧。W.00H-1。
請稱呼他為塔蒂奧。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Not revealing the contents of the Memory Records by the corporation.
Attacking you at Juperos was all because I wanted to.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
我不會透露公司記憶音盤的內容。
在朱諾攻擊你們，完全是因為我想這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
To tell you this I have no choice but to reveal my identity.
I have prepared for this but.. it does not feel great.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
為了告訴你們這些，我不得不揭露自己的身份。
雖然我已經做好了準備...但感覺並不好。

scripts.text: Everybody seems frozen by the massive news.
scripts.translation: 似乎所有人都被這巨大的訊息震住了。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
I am the Tatio in the Memory Records you have discovered.
And Atnad is Lasse Atnad, the great-grandfather of Dr. Atnad.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
我就是你們發現的記憶音盤中的塔蒂奧。
而阿特納德是拉塞·阿特納德，阿特納德醫生的曾祖父。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Lasse is one of the people who made me, and a friend.
I wanted to protect Verus, which is home to my undead machine body...
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
拉塞是製造我的人之一，也是我的朋友。
我想保護維魯斯，那是我的不宕機械之軀的故鄉...

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
I have committed that discourtesy that the time.
And on top of that, I had a hand on hiding what the doctor saw........
I manipulated his memory a bit.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
我在那時犯了那個無禮的錯誤。
而且，我還參與了隱瞞醫生看到的事情........
我稍微操縱了他的記憶。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
That is why you have that one week gap.
I took care of you for four days and sent you to the motel in Juno.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
這就是為什麼你們有一週的空白。
我照顧了你四天，然後把你送到了朱諾的旅館。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
I would not have done that if I knew you were a descendant of Lasse.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
如果我知道你是拉塞的後代，我就不會那樣做了。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Verus city a long.. long. Time ago was once side by side with Juperos..
No surpassed it as a great city of science with a scientific civilization.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
維魯斯城在很久...很久以前，曾與朱諾並駕齊驅..
甚至作為一個擁有科學文明的偉大城市超越了它。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Although an unfortunate accident turned it the way it is now.
I did not die because I was made of machines so I just watched over Verus.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
雖然不幸的事故讓它變成了現在的樣子。
我沒有死，因為我是由機器構成的，所以我只是守護著維魯斯。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
This story. Does the chairman know?
Wait. He already knows I bet. Isn't that why he called us here.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
這個故事。會長知道嗎？
等等。他肯定已經知道了。不然他為什麼叫我們來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
That is right.
The chairman knows of me and the Verus City secrets.
Only two in the whole world knew of this secret.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
是的。
會長知道我和維魯斯城的秘密。
全世界只有兩個人知道這個秘密。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Ah, No. One of the founders, Janet Zerter knows of this as well.
Also one of the descendants of Verus City.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
啊，不。創始人之一，珍妮特·澤特也知道這個。
她也是維魯斯城的後裔。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
.....Do you now understand my previous proposal?
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
.....你現在明白我之前的提議了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Oh oh well...
Although open, Verus City is still something you want to protect ..I see.
That is why the Memory Records...
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
哦，好吧...
雖然開放，但維魯斯城仍然是你想保護的東西..我明白了。
這就是為什麼記憶音盤...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Then this doesn't apply to the other data in the city?
You're trying to hide it to prevent your's and my name being revealed and becoming a public issue, right?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
那麼這不適用於城市中的其他資料？
你試圖隱藏它，以防止你和我被揭露併成為公共問題，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
The quantum level core technology unsuitable for this world's civilization has already been discarded.
Just like how lethal weapons are not put in the hands of children.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
不適合這個世界文明的量子級核心技術已經被丟棄。
就像致命武器不會放在孩子手中一樣。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
Although most of the data has been lost by accident...
You will probably gain plenty with what is now remaining.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
雖然大部分資料因事故而丟失...
但憑藉現在剩下的，你可能會獲得很多。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Why did you reveal it?
Should have wrapped it tightly instead.
Like you did to me.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你為什麼揭露它？
應該把它緊緊包裹起來。
就像你對我做的那樣。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
..To be honest, the first reason is that I could not easily approach the laboratories because of the energy storms during the time
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
說實話，最初的原因是因為當時能量風暴肆虐，我無法輕易接近實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
And because although I do not know the reason the energy storms disappeared and
I assessed it as not being too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
雖然我不知道能量風暴為何消失，但我評估認為現在的危險程度已經不高了。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
The right time to reveal it has came.
This place has also come to understand what is science and engineering.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
揭示真相的時機已經成熟。
這裡的人們也開始理解科學與工程了。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
.. Something is doubtful, but okay.
I guess I should be satisfied at even having this kind of opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
雖然有些疑點，但算了。
能有這樣的機會，我也該滿足了。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
I thank you for understanding.
I will give you sole rights to the Memory Records.
However the revealing of information and timing must be decided here.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
謝謝你的理解。
我將授予你記憶音盤的獨家權利。
但資訊的公開方式和時機，必須由這裡決定。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
And... In order to avoid affecting our descendants
we should keep it a secret between us as well.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
還有...為了避免影響我們的後代，
這件事我們也必須守口如瓶。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
I understand that.
Then I will handle the collecting of the Memory Records as I have been until now.
I will decide to report directly or not through you.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我明白了。
那麼，我會像往常一樣負責收集記憶音盤。
至於是否直接向你彙報，由我決定。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
That is it, right?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
就是這樣，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
That is right.
In reality there is not much change to the actual work.
Ah also...
For working diligently as a member of the Atnad excavation team..
{0} I will give you a small reward.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
沒錯。
實際上，具體的工作內容並沒有太大變化。
啊，對了...
鑑於你作為阿特納德挖掘隊成員辛勤工作...
{0} 我會給你一點小獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
The contents of the Memory Records are precious memories to me.
...It is like going through my diary. So I hope you take care in the future.
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
記憶音盤的內容對我來說是珍貴的回憶。
...就像翻看我的日記一樣。所以希望你今後能妥善保管。

scripts.text:
[Tatio]
...I hope everything goes smoothly with this...
scripts.translation:
[塔蒂奧]
...希望一切順利...

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Have you arrived now?
It seems everybody has gathered.
So, let's see what it was you had to say to everybody.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
你終於到了？
看來大家都聚齊了。
那麼，讓我們聽聽你有什麼要對大家說的。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So, what do you want to say?
What is it that you cut me off in this important moment.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
所以，你想說什麼？
為什麼在這個關鍵時刻打斷我。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
We keep losing the point.
Shouldn't you ask why he attacked me first.
Let's please listen to what he has to say. Daughter.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我們總是抓不住重點。
你不該先問問為什麼他攻擊我。
請聽聽他有什麼要說的。女兒。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
It is confusing to hear a surprising story at once but
At the same time it's cathartic.
Hm.. I see. I see.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
一下子聽到這麼驚人的故事確實讓人困惑，
但同時也讓人如釋重負。
嗯.. 我明白了。我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
What that man just said, was the incident of your disappearance?
The reason why you were running around outside for years.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
剛才那個男人說的，是你失蹤的那件事？
也就是你多年來在外奔波的原因。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
No.. it's not that..
The time I was with the doctor was only four days.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
不.. 不是那樣..
我和醫生在一起的時間只有四天。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
Before you said you were stuck somewhere for a week!
And running around like you were possessed by a ghost!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
你之前說你在某處被困了一週！
還像被幽靈附身一樣到處亂跑！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
That.. that..!
Don't treat my passion for my field like a runaway ghost!
At the time I thought I was going to find something about my grand-grandfather..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
那.. 那..！
別把我的專業熱情當成失控的幽靈！
當時我以為能發現一些關於我曾祖父的事情..

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The place I saw.. The memory I had of that place...
.....
...?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我看到的景象.. 我對那個地方的記憶...
.....
...？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Wait a minute. Are you blaming me now?
I sent letters home, but you were the one who didn't reply!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
等一下。你現在是在怪我嗎？
我明明寄了信回家，可你才是那個不回覆的人！

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
All the letters were sent back because the address wasn't clear!
Why are you talking big!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
那些信全都因為地址不清被退回來了！
你憑什麼這麼大聲！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
And didn't you sell the house and sent all my letters back!
You couldn't wait a few years so sell the house and disappear?!
What do you have to say for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
而且不是你賣掉了房子，把我的信全都退回來嗎？
你就不能多等幾年，非要賣房然後消失嗎？！
你還有什麼好說的！

scripts.text:
The situation is overheating due to the fight between father and daughter.
Aures and the secretary giving embarrassed looks.
scripts.translation:
父女倆的爭吵讓氣氛變得火熱。
奧雷斯和秘書尷尬地交換著眼神。

scripts.text: Should the table be turned over?
scripts.translation: 掀翻桌子？

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
What's that sound..
An..anyway isn't that secretary the main instigator of this whole incident?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
那是什麼聲音..
啊..總之，那個秘書不就是這次事件的主要始作俑者嗎？
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Aures]
Now you are here.
Sit here comfortably.
Although it might uncomfortable to sit on the corporation toilet.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
既然你來了。
就坐在這裡吧。
雖然坐在公司的廁所上可能不太舒服。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
It is amusing to see those two together.
Seems you cannot trick blood.
Seeing how they talk alike.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
看到這兩個人在一起真是有趣。
看來血緣是無法欺騙的。
看他們說話的方式就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Aures]
I loathe fighting but.. It is fun to see them together. Yes.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷斯]
我討厭打架，但..看著他們在一起挺有意思的。是的。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
Let's see if you gathered all of us to give us some bombastic story.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
讓我們看看，你是不是把我們召集起來只是為了講一些誇張的故事。

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
So, what do you want to say?
What is it that you cut me off in this important moment.
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
所以，你想說什麼？
為什麼在這個關鍵時刻打斷我。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
What that man just said, was the incident of your disappearance?
The reason why you were running around outside for years.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
剛才那個男人說的，是你失蹤的那件事？
也就是你多年來在外奔波的原因。

scripts.text:
[Chief Secretary]
No.. it's not that..
The time I was with the doctor was only four days.
scripts.translation:
[首席秘書]
不.. 不是那樣..
我和醫生在一起的時間只有四天。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
Before you said you were stuck somewhere for a week!
And running around like you were possessed by a ghost!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
你之前說你在某處被困了一週！
還像被幽靈附身一樣到處亂跑！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
That.. that..!
Don't treat my passion for my field like a runaway ghost!
At the time I thought I was going to find something about my grandfather..
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
那.. 那..！
別把我的專業熱情當成失控的幽靈！
當時我以為能發現一些關於我祖父的事情..

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
The place I saw.. The memory I had of that place...
.....
...?
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
我看到的景象.. 我對那個地方的記憶...
.....
...？

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
Wait a minute. Are you blaming me now?
I sent letters home, but you were the one who didn't reply!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
等一下。你現在是在怪我嗎？
我明明寄了信回家，可你才是那個不回覆的人！

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
All the letters were sent back because the address wasn't clear!
Why are you talking big!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
那些信全都因為地址不清被退回來了！
你憑什麼這麼大聲！

scripts.text:
[Ian Atnad]
And didn't you sell the house and sent all my letters back!
You couldn't wait a few years so sell the house and disappear?!
What do you have to say for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[伊恩·阿特納德]
而且不是你賣掉了房子，把我的信全都退回來嗎？
你就不能多等幾年，非要賣房然後消失嗎？！
你還有什麼好說的！

scripts.text:
The situation is overheating due to the fight between father and daughter.
Aures and the secretary giving embarrassed looks.
scripts.translation:
父女倆的爭吵讓氣氛變得火熱。
奧雷斯和秘書尷尬地交換著眼神。

scripts.text: Should the table be turned over?
scripts.translation: 掀翻桌子？

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
What's that sound..
An..anyway isn't that secretary the main instigator of this whole incident?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
那是什麼聲音..
啊..總之，那個秘書不就是這次事件的主要始作俑者嗎？
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
.......Let's keep listening to that secretary guy.
If give me nonsense I'm going to flip this company over.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
.......讓我們繼續聽那個秘書的傢伙說吧。
如果他再胡言亂語，我就把這家公司掀翻。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
So he means we can know the embarrassing past of the secretary by collecting and listening to the Memory Records?
That is kind of interesting.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
所以他的意思是，我們可以通過收集並聆聽記憶音盤，來了解那個秘書的尷尬過去？
這還挺有趣的。

scripts.text:
[Arquien]
What are you doing?
Let's go back now.
To the city that was too good for its own good.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾奎恩]
你在幹什麼？
我們現在就回去。
回到那個因為太好而自食其果的城市。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Investigations are supposed to be done calmly...
scripts.translation:
[杜]
調查應該是冷靜進行的...

scripts.text:
[Du]
Isn't this a complete mess?
Whew, barely got in!
I hate these access protocols.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
這簡直是一團糟！
呼，勉強進來了！
我討厭這些准入協議。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Right!
Our job is to investigate that!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
沒錯！
我們的任務就是調查那個！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I think it's an essential protocol needed for safety.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
我認為這是為了安全所必需的協議。

scripts.text:
[Du]
You guys, look at this!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
你們看這個！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Isn't this a complete mess?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
這簡直是一團糟！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hey...
Didn't you just say that?
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
嘿...
你剛才不是才這麼說的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Hey.
Forget about that and let's start on the investigation instead.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
好了。
別管那些了，我們開始調查吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
By the way I think I know why only this place was sealed off.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
順便說一下，我覺得我知道為什麼只有這個地方被封鎖了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
There are no intact buildings and the cracks on the ground are much more severe compared to other areas...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
這裡沒有完好的建築，而且地面的裂縫比其他地方嚴重得多...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Not to mention these monsters...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
還有這些魔物...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
It seems they are only found here so something is wrong...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
它們似乎只在這裡出現，肯定有什麼不對勁...

scripts.text:
[Du]
Right!
Our job is to investigate that!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
沒錯！
我們的任務就是調查那個！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Come to think of it the people passing by earlier did say there is an incredible device in the center...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
說起來，剛才路過的人說中心有一個不可思議的裝置...

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Then let's investigate that part first.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
那我們先去調查那一部分吧。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Coooooooooolll!!!!
See this?
Right here!!!!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
太酷了！！！！
看到沒？
就在這裡！！！！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Doesn't it look like something will go swirly?!
Haaa!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
看起來馬上就要旋轉起來了？！
哈啊！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
I wish I could take the whole thing to my laboratory!
I can only watch on...
scripts.translation:
[水果]
我真想把整個東西都帶回我的實驗室！
但我只能看著...

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
So I was thinking...
I was busy here so I haven't been able to go down to the underground bunker they say is right underneath.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
所以我在想...
我剛才一直在這裡忙，沒能去下面看看。聽說就在正下方有一個地下碉堡。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
你想去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
It isn't common to have someone tell you all the investigation points, right?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
有人把所有調查點都告訴你，這可不常見吧？

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
I am not asking you to work for free either!
If you bring back interesting results there will be rewards!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
我也沒讓你白乾！
如果你帶回有趣的結果，會有獎勵的！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Eh...

Yahoo!!!

scripts.translation:

耶！！！
進去走一段路，應該會有人指引你的。

I will be expecting you to bring back lots of fun stuff.

scripts.text:

I will be expecting you to bring back lots of fun stuff.

我等著看你帶回很多有趣的東西。

scripts.text:

How, is there any progress in the investigation?
Although it is an underground bunker, the scale is not a joke!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
喂，調查有進展嗎？
雖然是個地下碉堡，但規模可不小！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Wouldn't it be lost?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
不會弄丟吧？

Aarrghhhh!!!
Amazing!!!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
啊啊啊啊！！！
太棒了！！！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
So? So? Then what?
Come on! Tell me more!!!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
然後呢？然後呢？後來怎麼樣了？
快說！繼續說！！！

scripts.text:

Hm... Is there anything more interesting?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
嗯...還有什麼更有趣的事情嗎？

scripts.translation:

用17個完整的機械零件，我會給你裝備作為交換！

scripts.translation: 破損晶片 1

Runaway Chip is HIT + 50, FLEE + 50, MSP - 50%
scripts.translation:

爆走晶片：命中 + 50，移花接木 + 50，魔法速度 - 50%

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
When equipped together with Broken Chip 1 and Broken Chip 2, you get unlimited movement acceleration.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
與破損晶片 1 和破損晶片 2 同時裝備時，可獲得無限移動加速。

ATK and MATK + 50. If helmet refinement is at 9, it has an affect of MSP + 50%, MHP + 10%.
scripts.translation:

攻擊和魔法攻擊 + 50。如果頭盔精煉度達到 +9，則擁有魔法速度 + 50%，魔法HP + 10% 的效果。

Broken Chip 1 has STR + 4. If equipped with Broken Chip 2, it has a STR + 8, INT+ 8 affect.

破損晶片 1：力量 + 4。若與破損晶片 2 同時裝備，則擁有力量 + 8，智力 + 8 的效果。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Broken Chip 2 has INT + 4. If equipped with Broken Chip 1, it has a STR + 8, INT+ 8 affect.
scripts.translation:
[水果]
破損晶片 2：智力 + 4。若與破損晶片 1 同時裝備，則擁有力量 + 8，智力 + 8 的效果。

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 兌換

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Not enough!!!
scripts.translation:
[水果]
不夠！！！

scripts.text:
[Fruit]
Is this not what you wanted?
scripts.translation:
[水果]
這不是你想要的嗎？

scripts.text:
This part is very pristinely preserved compared to the upper parts.
But this disgusting smell....
scripts.translation:
與上層相比，這裡的儲存狀況非常完好。
但這股令人作嘔的氣味……

scripts.text:
[Mark]
The Undead not seen in other areas can be easily seen in this zone.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
在其他區域看不到的不死族，在這個區域很容易看到。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
If you look at the structure of this place...
Or the condition, I think this place was built to be used as a bunker.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
看看這裡的地形結構...
或者看它的狀況，我覺得這個地方是作為碉堡建造的。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then that means... The Undead...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那麼也就是說... 那些不死族...

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Eeeeeeeeeeek!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
It might be a good idea to calm down first...and look around thoroughly.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
先冷靜下來...然後仔細看看周圍的情況。

scripts.text: It might be a good idea to calm down first...and look around thoroughly.
scripts.translation: 先冷靜下來...然後仔細看看周圍的情況。

scripts.text:
[Du]
O...o...o...okay!
Thi...thi...this stuff..... is...is nothing...
scripts.translation:
[杜]
好...好...好吧！
這...這些東西...沒什麼大不了的...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Then let's look around individually and send a signal when something of value is found.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
那我們分開行動吧，發現有價值線索時發出訊號。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wa...wait!!
Wouldn't it be better to move together since it's dangerous?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
等...等等！！
這裡很危險，一起行動不是更好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Hey!
Look!
Don't leave me!
Hey!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
嘿！
看那邊！
別丟下我！
嘿！！！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wait for me!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
等等我！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
What is this disgusting smell?
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
這是什麼噁心的味道？

scripts.text:
[Alph]
There are too many suspicious places...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
可疑的地方太多了...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Um...
You're here...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
嗯...
你在這裡...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
I didn't send the signal yet but did you come here because you also got a strange feeling?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
我還沒發訊號，你是因為感覺到什麼才來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alph]
A long time ago...
...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
很久以前...
...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
No...no.
Let's call the others and start the investigation.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
不...不。
叫其他人過來，開始調查吧。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Investigate.
scripts.translation: 調查

scripts.text:
[Alph]
...
Don't forget our goal is to investigate...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
...
別忘了我們的目標是調查...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
I just sent out the signal so the others will arrive soon.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
我剛發了訊號，其他人很快就會到。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Aaarghhhh!!!!
Get away you unctuous bastards!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
啊啊啊啊啊！！
滾開，你們這群噁心的傢伙！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Be quiet...
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
安靜點...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Is there something special about this room?
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
這個房間有什麼特別之處嗎？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Oh! The woman at the entrance earlier?
Why are you at a dangerous place like this?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哦！是剛才在入口的那個女子？
你怎麼會在這種危險的地方？

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Oh?
Did you not hear?
That..
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
哦？
你沒聽到嗎？
那個...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Come to think of it that girl did say there would probably be a guide.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
說起來，那個女孩確實說過可能會有嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
....Um...
Was there...

[Mark]
Anyway it seems everybody is here so let's go in.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
總之，既然大家都到齊了，就進去吧。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Right...
There's a bad energy so be careful...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
好的...
這裡有一股不祥的氣息，請小心...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Is there more left to investigate in this room?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
這個房間裡還有其他需要調查的地方嗎？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Go in.

[Alph]
...
Don't forget our goal is to investigate...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
...
別忘了我們的目標是調查...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Right...
There's a bad energy so be careful...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
好的...
這裡有一股不祥的氣息，請小心...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
As expected..
Only this room has a different lay out than the rest...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
果然...
只有這個房間的佈局與其他地方不同...

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I see.
There's a door that doesn't seem to belong in a very unnatural location.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
我明白了。
有一扇門出現在非常不自然的位置。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
...There is no other way but to go in and investigate ourselves?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
...看來除了進去調查，別無他法？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Charge!!!!!

[Alph]
Unnatural room... Unnatural door...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
不自然的房間...不自然的門...

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Go in.
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text:
[Alph]
...

[Alph]
Haa...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
哈...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
This space is suffocating.
My head is starting to throb already.
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
這個空間令人窒息。
我的頭已經開始疼了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
What is this space?

scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
這是什麼地方？
作為掩體來說，建造得相當粗糙...

scripts.text:
[Alph]
The disgusting smell has gotten worse...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
那股惡臭越來越重了...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
There looks to be another door there so let's check it out.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那邊好像還有一扇門，我們去看看吧。

scripts.text: Leave.

scripts.text:
[Verity]
...Should have brought some painkillers for headaches.
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
...真該帶點止痛藥治頭痛的。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Are you quitting the investigation?
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
你要放棄調查嗎？

scripts.translation: - 無法進入該地點 -

You want to leave a place like this alone?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
你想就這樣離開這種地方嗎？

[Du]
Alright then....

Two!
Three!

[杜]
好吧……
一！
二！
三！

[Du]
Wow...What is this place?

[杜]
哇……這是什麼地方？

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Ah...Ah...
scripts.translation:

啊……啊……

The...door....

那……門……

scripts.translation:

作為秘密空間，它有一種微妙的感覺……

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Door...door....
scripts.translation:
[瑪姬]
門……門……

[Du]

scripts.translation:
[杜]
瑪姬，你在那發什麼呆？

[瑪姬]
門……卡住了。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Eh?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
What?!?!?
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Argh!!!
It's true?!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
啊！！！
是真的嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Are we all trapped here?!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
我們都被困在這裡了嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Wa..wait let's think about this stoically.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
等……等等，讓我們冷靜地思考一下。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Oh no what do we do...
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
糟糕，我們該怎麼辦……

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Ah...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾夫]
啊……

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Since there is no way to get out, should we go further inside?
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
既然沒有出去的路，我們要不要繼續往裡面走？

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wait... Come to think Verity!
You say you are a guide and you don't know the way out?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
等等……仔細想想，薇麗蒂！
你自稱是嚮導，卻不知道出口在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Verity]
This is the first time for me go in this deep...
There is no other way!
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
這是我第一次走到這麼深的地方……
沒有別的路了！

scripts.text:
[Du]
Wow...What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[杜]
哇……這是什麼地方？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
It is a really suspicious place...
I didn't think such a space would exist inside a bunker...
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
這裡真的很可疑……
我沒想到地堡裡面會有這樣的空間……

scripts.text: There is a weird piece.
scripts.translation: 有一塊奇怪的碎片。

scripts.text:
I cannot tell how long it has been since I entered this place.
In this darkness my sense of time grows dull and the people are quickly growing tired.
scripts.translation:
我已經記不清自己進入這裡多久了。
在這黑暗中，我對時間的感知變得遲鈍，大家也很快變得疲憊不堪。

scripts.text: They talk of escaping without knowing the outside situation... Is this the right choice?
scripts.translation: 他們在不瞭解外面情況的情況下談論著逃脫……這是正確的選擇嗎？

scripts.text:
But we have already lost our way back.
Yes.... This was not an escape.
Merely fleeing to survive...
scripts.translation:
但我們已經迷失了回去的路。
是的……這並非逃脫。
只是為了生存而逃竄……

scripts.text: How long can we keep running?
scripts.translation: 我們還能這樣跑多久？

scripts.text:
Even though I was ready for this, the situation is deteriorating.
I can only say I would not have survived if I stayed at that place.
scripts.translation:
儘管我早有準備，但情況正在惡化。
我只能說，如果當時留在那個地方，我肯定活不下來。

scripts.text: Hope...
scripts.translation: 希望……

scripts.text: Many have already become incapable of hope...
scripts.translation: 許多人已經無法抱有希望了……

scripts.text: We should have been out by now according to the calculations but there is only dirt still.
scripts.translation: 按照計算，我們現在應該已經出去了，但眼前依然只有泥土。

scripts.text:
The calculations could be wrong and we may be going in circles.
It doesn't feel right.
scripts.translation:
計算可能有誤，我們也許只是在繞圈子。
感覺不對勁。

scripts.text:
No..
I haven't felt at ease since that day.
scripts.translation:
不……
從那天起，我就再也沒有感到過安心。

scripts.text: There is a weird piece.
scripts.translation: 有一塊奇怪的碎片。

scripts.text:
I may have reached my limits.
I must blame my overtaxed body for not listening to me now.
scripts.translation:
我可能已經到達極限了。
我必須責怪這過度勞累的身體，它現在不聽使喚了。

scripts.text: The numbers of survivors are dwindling.
scripts.translation: 倖存者的數量正在減少。

scripts.text:
Like this...
I thought it was karma that I am witnessing the end...
Perhaps it is my selfishness.
I don't think there is no such time left for me..
scripts.translation:
就這樣……
我曾以為這是命運，讓我見證終結……
也許是我的自私。
我覺得自己已經沒有時間了……

scripts.text: Even walking is difficult now.
scripts.translation: 現在連走路都很困難。

scripts.text:
Once I confidently claimed I will lead all of us...
I find myself pathetic for becoming a burden much less of help.
scripts.translation:
我曾自信地宣稱會帶領我們所有人……
如今發現自己不僅幫不上忙，反而成了累贅，真是可悲。

scripts.text:
Everything is regretful.
Everything I started...
Everything of mine...
scripts.translation:
一切都令人後悔。
我所開始的一切……
屬於我的一切……

scripts.text: It would be better to abandon me...
scripts.translation: 把我拋棄掉……或許會更好……

scripts.text: The days I am asleep are outnumbering the days I am awake now.
scripts.translation: 如今，我沉睡的日子已經超過了清醒的日子。

scripts.text: I suddenly picture his face in my increasingly hazy consciousness.
scripts.translation: 在逐漸模糊的意識中，我忽然浮現出他的面容。

scripts.text: Tatio...
scripts.translation: 塔蒂奧……

scripts.text: A person sweet to me even though all I only cared about was my work.
scripts.translation: 儘管我只關心工作，他卻對我如此溫柔。

scripts.text:
Ha... person...
I cannot endure the shame of my past for considering him a mere successful project.'
scripts.translation:
哈……人……
回想起過去曾將他視為一個成功的專案，這份羞恥讓我難以忍受。

scripts.text:
Though I cannot help that I may die here...
If only to apologize to him...
If only to muster one sweet word, I have thoughts of survival.
scripts.translation:
雖然我知道自己可能會死在這裡……
如果能向他道歉……
如果能鼓起勇氣說出一句溫柔的話，我就有了求生的念頭。

scripts.text: ..Is it possible?
scripts.translation: ……這有可能嗎？

scripts.text: There is a weird piece.
scripts.translation: 有一塊奇怪的碎片。

scripts.text: debugging
scripts.translation: 除錯中

scripts.text:
File...error...restore...
Operation...range...25%...30%...35%.......
45%...50%... Minimal normal operations possible start safety mode operations
scripts.translation: 45%...50%... 啟動安全模式，維持最低限度的正常運作

scripts.text: 60% movement speed normal. Bodily functions normal.
scripts.translation: 60% 移動速度恢復正常。身體機能正常。

scripts.text: 70% Most language function restored. Slight symptoms of septic anemia but it seems it will be fixed soon.
scripts.translation: 70% 大部分語言功能已恢復。有輕微的貧血症狀，但似乎很快就能治癒。

scripts.text:
80% Surgery was fairly successful despite having had no proper preparations.
Planning to apply treatment to the rest of the survivors based on this success.
scripts.translation:
80% 儘管沒有充分的準備，手術相當成功。
計劃基於此次成功，對剩餘的倖存者進行治療。

scripts.text:
98% Corrupt sector detected.
For more effective operations I have copied the memory chip and constructed 'T_W_O_002b.'
There seems to have been some loss of data during the copying process...
scripts.translation:
98% 檢測到損壞扇區。
為了更有效地運作，我複製了記憶晶片並構建了“T_W_O_002b”。
複製過程中似乎丟失了一些資料……

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務 -

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
... It seems the last survivors have lingered here...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
……看來最後的倖存者一直留在這裡……

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I feel scared to open the next door for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
不知為何，我有些害怕開啟下一扇門。

scripts.text: Open door.
scripts.translation: 開啟門

scripts.text: Open door.
scripts.translation: 開啟門

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
There is a bitter feeling of sorts...
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
心中湧起一股苦澀的感覺...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Hello.
Are you here for the underground bunker investigation?
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
你好。
你是來調查地下碉堡的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Use gravity safety device
scripts.translation: 使用重力安全裝置

scripts.text:
[Verity]
It seems very dangerous below so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
下面似乎非常危險，請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
If you consider the appearance of monsters not seen in other areas, something is...
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
如果考慮到那些在其他區域從未見過的魔物，那麼這裡似乎...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
You can easily reach the entrance of the last room by using the gravity safety device.
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
使用重力安全裝置可以輕易到達最後的房間的入口。

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
I see you do not have the gravity safety device with you.
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
看來你身上沒有攜帶重力安全裝置。

scripts.text: [Verity]
scripts.translation: [薇麗蒂]

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Is that so?
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[薇麗蒂]
是嗎？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am sorry, only permitted excavation team members are permitted access.
If you work hard with your current excavation team the permit will come.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，只有獲准的挖掘團隊成員才能進入。
如果你在當前挖掘團隊中努力工作，許可很快就會下來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This place can only be accessed by permitted members.
Where are you coming from?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個地方只有獲准的成員才能進入。
你是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text: I am coming from the atnad excavation
scripts.translation: 我來自阿特納德挖掘隊

scripts.text: Why am I prohibited?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我被禁止進入？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah. You are a member of the Atnad excavation team.
Yes I have confirmed you on the list.
Atnad excavators are permitted access.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊。你是阿特納德挖掘隊的成員。
是的，我在名單上確認過你。
阿特納德的挖掘者獲准進入。

scripts.text: Why is access prohibited?
scripts.translation: 為什麼禁止進入？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Verus City is divided into four large sections.
Did you know?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
維魯斯城分為四個主要區域。
你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The area currently open are the town and plaza.
While the reason is unknown this place has been closed off and prohibited.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前開放的區域是城鎮和廣場。
雖然原因不明，但這個地方已被封閉並禁止進入。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
During independent corporate investigations before excavator recruitment,
we found that there was a large explosion here and to check the safety of the area,
an inspection period was needed.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在招募挖掘者之前的獨立公司調查中，
我們發現這裡曾發生大爆炸，為了檢查區域的安全性，
需要一段檢查期。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is place currently not seen as a great risk other than the dangerous terrain and possibility of
being attacked by machines like the plaza, so access is limited only to the excavation team.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
除了危險的地形和像廣場那樣可能被機器攻擊的風險外，
目前這個地方不被視為重大風險，因此僅限挖掘團隊進入。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please note that the permit also includes the zone connected in the West.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請注意，通行證也包含西側相連的區域。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, since you are permitted you may enter freely from now on.
Then I expect there to be good results!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，既然您已獲得許可，從現在起可以自由進入。
期待您能取得良好的成果！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How is the research and investigation going?
The machines in the restricted area are quite dangerous so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
研究和調查進展如何？
限制區域內的機器相當危險，請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Scholar]
Hm.. This machine seems to be have been used for tracking something.
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾學者]
嗯……這臺機器似乎被用於追蹤某些東西。
你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Technician]
I think so as well.
This screen probably indicates the position or condition of what it is tracking or detecting.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾技師]
我也這麼認為。
這個螢幕可能顯示的是它正在追蹤或檢測的目標的位置或狀態。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Scholar]
Was it showing the situation of this closed area, perhaps?
It is presumed that it was impossible to directly enter based on the interior situation a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾學者]
也許是在顯示這個封閉區域的情況？
根據之前的內部情況推測，當時應該是無法直接進入的。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Technician]
Probably so.
We can assume there was a large explosion just by observation with our eyes..
Then the reason for the people outside to install something like this ....
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾技師]
很有可能。
僅憑肉眼觀察，我們就能推斷出這裡發生過巨大的爆炸……
那麼，外面的人安裝這種東西的原因……

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Scholar]
Yes. It is to find out the interior situation.
Maybe.. there was a big accident so it might be for searching for survivors..
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾學者]
是的，是為了查明內部的情況。
也許……因為發生了重大事故，所以是為了搜救倖存者……

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Technician]
Indeed. You are probably right.
And our role is to find out the secrets of what happened here.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯貝爾技師]
確實如此。你說得對。
而我們的職責，就是查明這裡發生的一切真相。

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Hey, Kobell. If we want to be chosen as an outstanding excavation team...!
scripts.translation:
[塞西爾]
嘿，科貝爾。如果我們想成為優秀的挖掘團隊……！

scripts.text:
[Kobell]
To be..?
scripts.translation:
[科貝爾]
成為……？

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Is to figure out the identity of these unknown mechanical devices!
scripts.translation:
[塞西爾]
就要弄清楚這些未知機械裝置的來歷！

scripts.text:
[Kobell]
Whaat? How did this happen?
We didn't even major in engineering!
scripts.translation:
[科貝爾]
什……什麼？怎麼會這樣？
我們甚至沒有主修工程學啊！

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
This place if full of machines! We can receive recognition like the Atnad excavators if we analyze them!
scripts.translation:
[塞西爾]
這裡到處都是機器！如果我們能解析它們，就能像阿特納德的挖掘者那樣獲得認可！

scripts.text:
[Kobell]
Aha! Indeed so.
But I think the Atnad excavators are around here...?
scripts.translation:
[科貝爾]
啊哈！確實如此。
不過我覺得阿特納德的挖掘者好像就在這附近……？

scripts.text:
[Cecil]
Hah! Our research goals cannot be discovered. This is a secret between you and I!
scripts.translation:
[塞西爾]
哈！我們的研究目標不能被發現。這是我們倆之間的秘密！

scripts.text:
[Kobell]
Let's do that~
scripts.translation:
[科貝爾]
那就這麼辦吧~

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I am Monthly Brigan's senior reporter Krotzel! As this place is revealed to the many, many Adventurers are gathering here.
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
我是《布里刊》的資深記者克羅策爾！隨著這個地方被公開，許多冒險者正聚集到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I am most worried about the Probationary member. He is still new so won't know anything. It is highly possible he followed the veteran senior. If it is okay, can you find him?
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
我最擔心的是那位見習成員。他資歷尚淺，什麼都不知道。很有可能他跟隨了那位資深前輩。如果方便的話，你能幫我找到他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
If she followed the veteran senior she might have gone to the ruined area. If you find her please let me know where she is.
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
如果她跟隨了那位資深前輩，可能去了廢墟區域。如果你找到她，請告訴我她的位置。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
As I thought. I am glad he is at least safe. If it's okay can you find my colleague Sunny Kim as well?
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
果然如此。他至少平安無事，這讓我鬆了口氣。如果方便的話，能幫我找一下我的同事桑尼·金嗎？

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
We got along well since joining and eventually made a team together so I cannot help but be worried.
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
我們入行後相處得很好，最終還組成了搭檔，所以我實在忍不住擔心。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I don't think it can be helped that people will worry. The last veteran reporter, Grizzly Grylls! Designated survival reporter!
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
大家擔心也是人之常情。上一任資深記者，格里爾斯！那位被指定為“生存記者”的人！

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Find me Grizzly Grylls, veteran reporter who can survive anywhere. I think he may be in the ruins to the east...
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
請幫我找到格里爾斯，那位能在任何地方生存下來的資深記者。我想他可能在東邊的廢墟里...

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Good! So everybody is safe. Everybody will create a news item on their own, right?
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
太好了！看來大家都平安無事。大家都會各自撰寫新聞稿，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
You're the adventurer I met last time! Our team members still haven't returned so I am worried. If it's okay, can you check if they are safe?
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
你是上次我遇到的那位冒險者！我的團隊成員還沒回來，我很擔心。如果方便的話，能幫我確認一下他們是否安全嗎？

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
I should check if everybody is safe. Please find and see if all three are working hard.
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
我應該確認一下大家是否安全。請找到他們，看看這三位是否都在努力工作。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Well we are all safe today. Because we are Adventure team 2! Thank you for helping!
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
好吧，今天大家都平安無事。畢竟我們是冒險團隊2！謝謝你的幫助！

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
[Krotzel]
I should check if everybody is safe.
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
[克羅策爾]
我應該確認一下大家是否安全。

scripts.text: [Krotzel]
scripts.translation: [克羅策爾]

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
It seems they are still working. I'm worried but I should be focusing on my work! We are the monthly Brigan Adventure team 2!
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
看來他們還在工作。雖然我很擔心，但我應該專注於自己的工作！我們是《布里刊》的冒險團隊2！

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Not a lot of information has been relayed to general Adventurers. So we are interviewing Adventurers ourselves! Doing the legwork and gathering information.
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
傳達給普通冒險者的資訊並不多。所以我們要親自採訪冒險者！親自跑腿收集情報。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Please give us good information if you have it. If it is a good piece of info we can give you a small reward.
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
如果您有好的情報，請提供給我們。如果是很有價值的情報，我們可以給您一點小獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
Who are we? We are Monthly Brigan's Adventure team 2...
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
我們是誰？我們是《布里刊》的冒險團隊2...

scripts.text:
[Krotzel]
...?
scripts.translation:
[克羅策爾]
...？

看起來有人來拜訪？
快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Nile]
What do you want to say?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
你想說什麼？

scripts.text: About the Last Exploration
scripts.translation: 關於最後的探索

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Ah, that..?
Forget about that.
Now that I think about it I need to hear it from him directly.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
啊，那個...
算了，別管那個了。
仔細想想，我需要直接聽他說。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
According to Aures he blindly clung onto Juperos..
I think I might know why he did that now.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
根據奧雷斯所說，他盲目地執著於朱佩羅斯...
我想我現在知道他為什麼那樣做了。

scripts.text: Perhaps for the contents in the Memory Records?
scripts.translation: 是為了記憶音盤裡的內容嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nile]
That's right.
The old man. My father probably vaguely knows as well.
He's looking for his roots.
Although it is my childhood memories, the grandfathers had a lot of secrets.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
沒錯。
那個老人。我父親大概也隱約知道一些。
他在尋找自己的根源。
雖然那是我的童年記憶，但祖父們有很多秘密。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Even so... haha. Can I really be a descendant of this area of Verus?
It's probably just the same name. Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
即便如此...哈哈。我真的可能是這片維魯斯地區的後裔嗎？
大概只是同名而已。哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Hey. I don't have that much time to spare okay?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
嘿。我沒那麼多時間浪費，好嗎？

scripts.text: This thing is currently playing..
scripts.translation: 這臺裝置正在播放...

scripts.text: Playing audible information of the Memory Record.
scripts.translation: 正在播放記憶音盤中的音訊資訊。

scripts.text: All audible information in the Memory Record has been played.
scripts.translation: 記憶音盤中的所有音訊資訊已播放完畢。

scripts.text: Playing audible information of the Memory Record.
scripts.translation: 正在播放記憶音盤中的音訊資訊。

scripts.text: All audible information in the Memory Record has been played.
scripts.translation: 記憶音盤中的所有音訊資訊已播放完畢。

scripts.text: As you try to eject the Memory Record, the connecting part breaks with a cracking sound and returns to it's disassembled form.
scripts.translation: 當你試圖取出記憶音盤時，連線部件發出咔嚓一聲斷裂，並恢復為拆解狀態。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Can you, not touch things without asking?
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
你能不能不經過允許就亂動東西？

scripts.text: There are no more Memory Records to play.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多可播放的記憶音盤了。

scripts.text: Playing audible information of the Memory Record.
scripts.translation: 正在播放記憶音盤中的音訊資訊。

scripts.text: All audible information in the Memory Record has been played.
scripts.translation: 記憶音盤中的所有音訊資訊已播放完畢。

scripts.text: All audible information in the Memory Record has been played.
scripts.translation: 記憶音盤中的所有音訊資訊已播放完畢。

scripts.text: As you try to eject the Memory Record, the connecting part breaks with a cracking sound and returns to it's disassembled form.
scripts.translation: 當你試圖取出記憶音盤時，連線部件發出咔嚓一聲斷裂，並恢復為拆解狀態。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Darn. There's only one content but it annoyingly breaks every time it doesn't play.
I'm starting to think it's made like this on purpose.
Annoying to clean up..
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
該死。只有一個內容，但每次不播放時都會煩人地壞掉。
我開始覺得這是故意設計成這樣的。
清理起來真煩...

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Why make things like this with all that science and talent and whatnot?
Not to mention there is the occasional overlap..
It feels like someone is coaxing us to find out about the past no matter what.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
為什麼用那麼多科學和天賦做出這種東西？
更別提偶爾會出現重疊...
感覺像是有人在誘導我們無論如何都要了解過去。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Anyway I will record this content separately and deliver it to the old man.
Good work today.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
總之我會單獨記錄這個內容，並交給那個老人。
今天辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Then come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
那明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Nile]
Wait, something is going on?
That tent there is where the excavation team is, right?
It seems someone is visiting?
Go along now!
scripts.translation:
[尼羅]
等等，發生什麼事了？
那邊那個帳篷是挖掘隊駐紮的地方，對吧？
看起來有人來拜訪？
快去吧！

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務 -

scripts.text: Your whole body suddenly becomes heavy and time seems to be passing faster around you.
scripts.translation: 你的身體突然變得沉重，周圍的時間似乎流逝得更快了。

scripts.text: Your whole body suddenly becomes heavy and time seems to be passing faster around you.
scripts.translation: 你的身體突然變得沉重，周圍的時間似乎流逝得更快了。

scripts.text: Ah- This cozy and snug fe...el.....ling
scripts.translation: 啊...這種舒適而溫馨的感覺...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
First congratulations on surviving. I'm glad you got into the air-raid shelter. If you were outside..
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
首先恭喜你還活著。很高興你躲進了防空洞。如果你在外面...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
...
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Whew.. even thinking about it makes me dizzy. Both of us were lucky. Don't you think so?
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
呼...光是想想就讓我頭暈。我們兩個都挺幸運的，你覺得呢？

scripts.text: I think so too.
scripts.translation: 我也這麼覺得。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I feel a lot of sympathy though. It looks like a lot of people are blaming this explosion on Fresa.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
不過我挺同情的。看起來很多人都在把這次爆炸歸咎於弗雷薩。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
The explosion can't be only Lona's responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
這次爆炸不能只由洛娜一個人負責。

scripts.text: Lona?
scripts.translation: 洛娜？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
A great person for sure despite failing the experiment.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
儘管實驗失敗了，她絕對是個了不起的人。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
She took charge of figuring out the number of survivors in that confusing mess of a situation.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
在那種混亂的局面中，她主動承擔起統計倖存者數量的工作。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
If it was me...
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
如果是我...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I would probably be wandering around without knowing what do to right about now..
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
我現在大概正不知所措地四處遊蕩吧...

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ugh- I guess even I should go and help. Want to help?
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
唉——我想我也應該去幫忙。你想一起去嗎？

scripts.text: Agree to help.
scripts.translation: 同意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Really? You will help? What a relief because I wasn't confident about going by myself.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
真的嗎？你會幫忙？太好了，因為我自己去的話心裡沒底。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There is a researcher with a cold demeanor in the center of this room, right?
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
這個房間中央有一位神情冷淡的研究員，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
She is the head of the experiment, Lona Fresa. People usually call her Dr. Fresa.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
她是這次實驗的負責人，洛娜·弗雷薩。大家通常叫她弗雷薩博士。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Do you want to go and ask her if she needs any help?
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
你想去問問她是否需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There is a researcher with a cold demeanor in the center of this room, right?
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
這個房間中央有一位神情冷淡的研究員，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Do you want to go and ask her if she needs any help?
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
你想去問問她是否需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I was asked to find out how many are capable of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
我被要求去調查有多少人具備烹飪能力。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
We have to try hard even though the air-raid shelter is complex and wide.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
雖然防空洞結構複雜且面積很大，但我們必須努力尋找。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Thanks for helping her.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
謝謝你的幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Is it because we helped? I thought I saw a faint smile on her face.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
是因為我們幫忙了嗎？我好像看到她臉上浮現出一絲淡淡的微笑。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Uh?! I don't think I've seen you before in the air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
咦？我好像沒在防空洞裡見過你吧？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ah! Are you the Adventurer who's helping with moving the newly made air cleaning unit?
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
啊！你是那位正在協助搬運新制空氣淨化裝置的冒險者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
You are working a lot because of those thoughtless Mechanicians.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
因為那些魯莽的機械師，你可是忙壞了。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
The Bioengineers succeeded in cultivating grapes right?
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
聽說生物工程師們成功培育出了葡萄？

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
They say at least one grape harvest every 2 weeks is possible? The harvest day is probably either today or tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
據說每兩週至少能收穫一次？收穫日應該就在今天或明天。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I want to taste fresh grapes soon. I've been eating only dry food for the past few days.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
我好想快點嚐嚐鮮摘葡萄。這幾天我都在吃乾糧。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
There's a rumor going around in the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
防空洞裡流傳著一個謠言。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
A while ago the Chemical Substance Specialist and a few others went outside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
不久前，化學專家和其他幾個人曾離開過防空洞。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Apparently some contaminated substance got inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
據說某種受汙染的物質進入了防空洞。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I heard the number of convulsing patients are rapidly increasing because of the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
我聽說因為這種汙染物，抽搐病人的數量正在迅速增加。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Ah! It's just a rumor! A Rumor!!
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
啊！這只是謠言！是謠言！！

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
It seems the rumor going around was true.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
看來流傳的謠言是真的。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I hear they are moving supplies to the clean Zone Z-2 even though it's newly opened because of the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
聽說由於汙染物的影響，儘管Z-2區是新開放的潔淨區，他們還是要把物資轉移過去。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
I think I will lend a hand even just a little.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
我想我也許可以幫上一點忙。

scripts.text:
[Bunker Sayhu]
Nice to meet you, my name is Bunker Sayhu.
scripts.translation:
[掩體 賽胡]
幸會，我是掩體 賽胡。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I am sorry. Right now I am a little busy with several problems. Can we speak later?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
抱歉。我現在正忙著處理幾個問題。我們稍後再對話好嗎？

scripts.text: No! What I mean..
scripts.translation: 不！我的意思是...

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
What?! The Adventurer wants to help me?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
什麼？！這位冒險者想幫我？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Good. The people are uncontrollable because they are shocked and confused.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
很好。人們因為震驚和困惑而難以控制。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
If the intimidating Adventurer helps out it will be easier to control the confused masses.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
如果有這位令人敬畏的冒險者幫忙，控制這些驚慌失措的人群就會容易得多。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Good!! I approve. Just in time for a troublesome problem as well.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
很好！！我批准了。正好我也遇到一個棘手的問題。

scripts.text: Troublesome problem?
scripts.translation: 棘手的問題？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The personnel with various specialties such as yourself have not changed their positions and are easy to grasp, but the other employees are the problem.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
像您這樣擁有各種專業技能的人員並沒有改變位置，情況很容易掌握，但其他員工才是問題所在。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Surely they are moving according to the Emergency Situation Guidelines of their respective teams.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
他們肯定是在按照各自團隊的緊急情況指南行動。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I cannot figure out from here where they are and what they are doing.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
但我在這裡無法確定他們在哪裡，也不知道他們在做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
So I was thinking if you
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
所以我在想，如果你...

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you figure out the number of ^0000FFBioengineers ^000000?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能查出^0000FF生物工程師^000000的數量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you figure out the number of ^0000FFMechanicians^000000?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能查出^0000FF機械師^000000的數量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you figure out the number of ^0000FFFacilities managers^000000?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能查出^0000FF設施管理員^000000的數量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you figure out the number of ^0000FFChemical Substance Specialists^000000?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能查出^0000FF化學物質專家^000000的數量嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
I ask you for this favor even though it won't be easy in this large and complex shelter.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
儘管在這個龐大且複雜的避難所裡這並不容易，但我還是請求你幫這個忙。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Huh?! You're already back? You came back earlier than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
什麼？！你已經回來了？你比我預想的回來得早。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The favor that I asked.. ah?! Ah!!
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
我拜託你的事...啊？！啊！！

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFBioengineers^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF生物工程師^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFMechanicians^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF機械師^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFFacilities managers^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF設施管理員^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFChemical Substance Specialists^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF化學物質專家^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
{0} people you say?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你說有{0}人？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
That's strange? According to the list they have never been that number.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
這很奇怪？根據名單，人數從來沒有這麼多過。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you check again?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能再確認一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Ah! You are here. Isn't the interior of the shelter a bit complicated? The favor I asked of you..
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
啊！你來了。避難所內部的結構有點複雜吧？拜託你的那件事...

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFBioengineers^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF生物工程師^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFMechanicians^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF機械師^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFFacilities managers^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF設施管理員^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
The number of ^0000FFChemical Substance Specialists^000000? How many do they say have survived?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
^0000FF化學物質專家^000000的數量？據說有多少人倖存？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
{0} people you say?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你說有{0}人？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
That's strange? According to the list they have never been that number.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
這很奇怪？根據名單，人數從來沒有這麼多過。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Can you check again?
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
你能再確認一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Really? It is roughly the same as the number on the list. Good work.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
真的嗎？大概和名單上的數字差不多。幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Lona Fresa]
Sayhu says Adventurers like this kind of stuff. This is compensation for your help.
scripts.translation:
[洛娜·弗雷薩]
賽胡說冒險者都喜歡這種東西。這是對你幫忙的報酬。

scripts.text: The small round capsule has percolated through the skin. It feels like experience has accumulated.

scripts.translation:

Who are you?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text: I am...
scripts.translation: 我是...

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Ah! Ah! Fresa? I have met her a few times at plenary sessions.
scripts.translation:

啊！啊！芙蕾薩？我在幾次全體會議上見過她。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
If I recall she is the one in charge of this failed project?
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
如果我沒記錯的話，她是負責這個失敗專案的人？

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Anyway!!
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
總之！！

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Not everybody is fit to be director. A headcount in this hectic situation.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
並非每個人都適合擔任總監。在這種混亂的情況下清點人數。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Wait a minute. I did a headcount and wrote it down somewhere..
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
等一下。我做過人數清點，應該記在某個地方了...

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Was it this number? That number? Ah?! This number.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
是這個數字嗎？那個數字？啊？！是這個數字。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Total number of Chemical Substance Specialists is ^FF0000{0}^000000. Damn a lot less.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
化學物質專家總共有^FF0000{0}^000000人。天哪，少了很多。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Ah! Tell Fresa on your way that we are checking for hazardous substances within the air-raid shelter according to emergency protocol.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
啊！你走的時候告訴芙蕾薩，我們正在按照緊急協議檢查防空洞內的危險物質。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
We have to do our job even if there aren't many of us left.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
即使剩下的人不多，我們也必須做好自己的工作。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Total number of Chemical Substance Specialists is ^FF0000{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
化學物質專家總共有^FF0000{0}^000000人。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Our Chemical Substance Specialists are living like we always do. It's not like we can do chemical experiments in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
我們的化學物質專家過著和平時一樣的生活。在這種地方，我們沒法進行化學實驗。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
I've been eating nothing but dried food so eating fresh grape makes me feel fresh.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
我這幾天只吃乾糧，所以吃鮮摘葡萄讓我感覺很清爽。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Is that the first grape harvested by the Bioengineers?
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
那是生物工程師們收穫的第一批葡萄嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
The rumors say a grape tree got smashed because of the Mechanicians but it seems it hasn't affected the harvest.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
傳聞說因為機械師們，一棵葡萄樹被砸壞了，但看起來並沒有影響收成。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Karsten]
Anyway thanks. I prepared this for compensation.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 卡斯滕]
總之，謝謝。我準備了這個作為補償。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Are you an Adventurer? This is the machine warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你是冒險者嗎？這裡是機器倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
It was originally a warehouse but it is now being used by Mechanicians to assemble machines for the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
這裡原本是倉庫，但現在被機械師們用來組裝防空洞的機器。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
You want to know the total number of Mechanicians? I don't think I know?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你想知道機械師的總人數嗎？我想我不清楚？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Ah! Al up there might know. Go to Al.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
啊！阿爾應該知道。去找阿爾吧。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
An adventure to move the air cleaner?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
要移動空氣清淨機的冒險任務？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
You look solid just like the other researchers mentioned. I bet you can lift the air cleaner like nothing!!
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你看起來很有力氣，就像其他研究員說的那樣。我敢打賭你能輕鬆舉起空氣清淨機！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We shouldn't be ordering people like you who got caught up in an accident, but the situation is urgent.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
我們不應該命令像你這樣捲入事故的人，但情況很緊急。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We made a new air cleaning unit because the one operating previously broke down a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
因為之前執行的空氣清淨機壞了，我們製造了一臺新的空氣淨化單元。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We should have made it in modular form. Made it as one solid piece by mistake.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
本來應該做成模組化的。結果不小心做成了一個整體。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Didn't think of it when we were making it!!
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
製造的時候沒想到這一點！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
It happens. Right?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
這種事難免會發生，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Facilities managers are making a fuss about needing the air cleaning unit soon.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
設施管理員們正在大吵大鬧，說急需空氣淨化單元。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We can't move the air cleaning unit with the equipment we have now..
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
以我們現在的裝置，無法移動空氣淨化單元...

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We could make the machine that can transport it if we had more time..
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
如果有更多時間，我們可以製造一臺能運輸它的機器...

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
So we ended up asking the strong Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
所以我們只好求助於強壯的冒險者。

scripts.text: Yes sir.
scripts.translation: 遵命，長官。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Aren't you refreshing!!
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你真是令人耳目一新！！

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We are counting on you. Take five air cleaning units to areas C-0, F-1, F-2, I-0, Z-0. Talk to me when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
我們就指望你了。請將5個空氣淨化單元送到C-0、F-1、F-2、I-0、Z-0區域。準備好後請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Are you ready to move heavy objects?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你準備好搬運重物了嗎？

scripts.text: Give it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
You look strong but seems you are weak. You can't lift the air cleaning unit like that.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你看起來很強壯，但似乎力氣不夠。那樣是舉不起空氣淨化單元的。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Deliver them to zones C-0, F-1, F-2, I-0, Z-0. The order doesn't matter and please be careful since they are precise machines.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
請將它們送到C-0、F-1、F-2、I-0、Z-0區域。順序不限，請務必小心，因為它們是精密儀器。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Good work. The air cleaning units are heavy, right?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
幹得好。空氣淨化單元很重，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Sayhu says Adventurers like this kind of stuff and I should use this as compensation after giving you work.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
薩胡說冒險者喜歡這種東西，所以我應該把它作為給你工作的報酬。

scripts.text: The small round capsule has percolated through skin. It feels like experience has accumulated.
scripts.translation: 小圓膠囊已滲透皮膚。感覺經驗值已經積累起來了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Thanks to you we overcame a crisis. I need to make a machine that can move heavy objects in case this happens again.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
多虧了你，我們克服了危機。為了防止再次發生這種情況，我需要製造一臺能移動重物的機器。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Good work. Let's relax for now.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
幹得好。現在讓我們放鬆一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Have you tried the grapes made by the Bioengineers using that growth thingy?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
你嘗過生物工程師用那個生長裝置培育的葡萄了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
We can now eat fresh fruit in this dull and dark air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
在這個昏暗陰暗的防空洞裡，我們現在也能吃到新鮮的水果了。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Are you worried because people are suddenly attacking? What? You aren't infected right?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
因為人們突然開始攻擊，你感到擔心嗎？什麼？你沒有被感染吧？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Mugeosi]
Why is everybody rejecting us making a machine that can make shipping easier? Pssh!!
scripts.translation:
[機械師 穆格奧西]
為什麼大家都反對我們製造能簡化運輸的機器？哼！！
