[Facilities manager]
We are inspecting the interior facilities of the air-raid shelter according to emergency regulations.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
我們正根據緊急條例檢查防空洞的內部設施。

scripts.text:

Oh- You're here? I was waiting.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
哦——你來了？我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
I have heard Adventurers are all strong as oxen but it is still impressive.
scripts.translation:

我聽說冒險者都力大如牛，但這也確實令人印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
But where is the air cleaning unit? You didn't bring the most important thing. Bring it here.
scripts.translation:

但是空氣淨化單元在哪裡？你沒帶最重要的東西。把它帶過來。

scripts.text:

Good work. Good work. We have received the air cleaning unit.
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

你嘗過生物工程師製作的葡萄了嗎？

scripts.text:

Science is truly amazing to have us enjoy fresh grapes in this underground air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:

科學真神奇，讓我們在這個地下防空洞裡也能享受新鮮的葡萄。

I think the air cleaner might be useless because the contaminant has already infiltrated the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:

我覺得空氣清淨機可能沒用了，因為汙染物已經滲入防空洞了。

scripts.text:

You are going through a lot.
scripts.translation:

你經歷了很多。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
冒險者還沒送來空氣淨化單元嗎？啊？！在這裡。快...空氣淨化單元...

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Arwhat!! Why didn't you bring it. Bring it now, okay?
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
啊？！你怎麼沒帶過來。現在馬上帶來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
It's urgent. I'll thank you later..
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
情況緊急。之後我會感謝你的...

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Don't talk to me. Every hour is precious.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
別跟我說話。每一小時都很寶貴。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Have you tried the grape made by the Bioengineers?
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
你嘗過生物工程師製作的葡萄了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Science is truly amazing to have us enjoy fresh grapes in this underground air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
科學真神奇，讓我們在這個地下防空洞裡也能享受新鮮的葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
I think the air cleaner might be useless because the contaminant has already infiltrated the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
我覺得空氣清淨機可能沒用了，因為汙染物已經滲入防空洞了。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
You are going through a lot.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
你經歷了很多。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
I don't know who equipped the air-raid shelter. But it surely is well made and sturdy.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
我不知道是誰裝備了這個防空洞。但它確實建造得堅固耐用。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
We are inspecting the interior facilities of the air-raid shelter according to emergency regulations.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
我們正根據緊急條例檢查防空洞的內部設施。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Oh- You're here? I was waiting.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
哦——你來了？我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
I have heard Adventurers are all strong as oxen but it is still impressive.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
我聽說冒險者都力大如牛，但這也確實令人印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
But where is the air cleaning unit? You didn't bring the most important thing. Bring it here.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
但是空氣淨化單元在哪裡？你沒帶最重要的東西。把它帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Good work. Good work. We have received the air cleaning unit.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
幹得好。幹得好。我們已經收到空氣淨化單元了。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Good work. Good work. We have received the air cleaning unit.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
幹得好。幹得好。我們已經收到空氣淨化單元了。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Have you tried the grape made by the Bioengineers?
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
你嘗過生物工程師製作的葡萄了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
Science is truly amazing to have us enjoy fresh grapes in this underground air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
科學真神奇，讓我們在這個地下防空洞裡也能享受新鮮的葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
I think the air cleaner might be useless because the contaminant has already infiltrated the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
我覺得空氣清淨機可能沒用了，因為汙染物已經滲入防空洞了。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
You are going through a lot.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
你經歷了很多。

scripts.text:
[Facilities manager]
I don't know who equipped the air-raid shelter. But it surely is well made and sturdy.
scripts.translation:
[設施管理員]
我不知道是誰裝備了這個防空洞。但它確實建造得堅固耐用。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We Bioengineers are doing all we can to produce food for the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們生物工程師正在竭盡全力，為防空洞內的人們生產食物。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We Bioengineers are doing all we can to produce food for the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們生物工程師正在竭盡全力，為防空洞內的人們生產食物。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Are you the Adventurer here to help us with the grape harvest? Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
你是來幫助我們收穫葡萄的冒險者嗎？很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Bioengineers alone do not have enough hands to harvest the amount of grapes we need to provide all the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
僅靠生物工程師人手不夠，無法收穫足夠供應防空洞內所有人的葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
So we ended up asking the Adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
所以我們向冒險者發出了請求。

scripts.text: Are there others who can help?
scripts.translation: 還有其他能幫忙的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Don't even mention it. We gave the task of harvesting grapes to the meandering Mechanicians and..
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
別提了。我們把收穫葡萄的任務交給了遊蕩的機械師，結果...

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
They ended up smashing one of the grape trees!!
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
他們竟然砸壞了一棵葡萄樹！！

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We were lucky to have found out and stopped them before they destroyed the other trees. The thought of it is horrible.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
幸好我們發現得早，在他們毀掉其他樹之前制止了他們。想想就讓人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Ah! That is not what's important.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
啊！這不是重點。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We used growth acceleration to make ripe grapes drop periodically.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們使用了<死亡騎士>加速，讓成熟的葡萄定期掉落。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
It would be nice if you can wait in front of the grape tree and collect 30 bunches of grapes.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
如果你能站在葡萄樹前，收集30串葡萄，那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
You can collect more, but the remaining ones from the harvest will naturally decompose and disappear.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
你可以多收集一些，但收穫後剩餘的葡萄會自然分解消失。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Then the soil fertility will recover partially. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
之後土壤肥力會部分恢復。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We have decided to give out one grape box per team.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們決定每個隊伍發放一個葡萄箱。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
One box can hold 30~32 bunches so collect accordingly.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
一個箱子可以裝30~32串，請根據這個數量收集。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Whoa good job. As I thought Adventurers are so much more capable than Mechanicians.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
哇，幹得好。果然，冒險者比機械師能幹多了。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Since the grapes are harvested should we deliver them to each team?
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
既然葡萄已經收穫了，我們要把它們分發給各個隊伍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
I will be rude and ask you another favor on top of your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
在您辛苦工作之後，我還要厚顏地再拜託您一件事。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Let's see.. the grapes you just harvested
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
讓我想想...您剛才收穫的葡萄

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
should be delivered to the Mechanical AI team. You can deliver this to Mugeosi.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
應該送到機械AI團隊。您可以把它交給穆戈西。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
should be delivered to the Facilities manager team. You can deliver this to Remodeling.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
應該送到設施管理員團隊。您可以把它交給翻新。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
should be delivered to the Chemical Substance team. You can deliver this to Karsten.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
應該送到化學物質團隊。您可以把它交給卡爾斯滕。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Oh! You do not have to come back after the deliveries. We will be busy starting the next project.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
哦！送完貨後您不必回來。我們要開始下一個專案了，會很忙。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
The people receiving the deliveries will probably give you compensation. If they don't, you can nag them.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
接收貨物的人大概會給您報酬。如果他們不給，您可以去催他們。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
That grape box you are holding
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
您手裡拿著的那個葡萄箱

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
has to be delivered to Mugeosi of the Mechanical AI team.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
必須送到機械AI團隊的穆戈西那裡。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
has to be delivered to Remodeling of the Facilities manager team.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
必須送到設施管理員團隊的翻新那裡。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
has to be delivered to Karsten of the Chemical substance team.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
必須送到化學物質團隊的卡爾斯滕那裡。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
Compensation will be paid by the people receiving the deliveries so you do not have to come back here.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
報酬由接收貨物的人支付，所以您不必回到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
I thought I told you don't have to come back. Anyway how did you get inside?
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我明明告訴過您不用回來的。總之，您是怎麼進來的？

scripts.text:
[Bioengineer Ebrik]
We Bioengineers are doing all we can to produce food for the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation:
[生物工程師 埃布里克]
我們生物工程師正在竭盡全力，為防空洞內的人們生產食物。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Sorry. Did you wait long? There are a lot of suspected infection patients as you can see..
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
抱歉。您等了很久嗎？如您所見，有很多疑似感染的病人...

scripts.text: Not really..
scripts.translation: 沒有很久..

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Eh?! You didn't wait? That's strange? Did you cut in line? Cutting is bad.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
誒？！您沒等？這很奇怪？您插隊了？插隊是不好的。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
As you know there are infectees who are suddenly showing strange phenomena..
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
如您所知，有些感染者會突然表現出奇怪的現象..

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Um...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
...Ah...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
...啊...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
...Oh!!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
...哦！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I don't see any problematic symptoms. Fortunate.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
我沒有發現任何異常症狀。真是幸運。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
We are having trouble because of the suddenly convulsing patients.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
因為那些突然抽搐的病人，我們忙得不可開交。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Look here. My skin is getting crispy from not being able to sleep for days~
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
你看這裡。因為好幾天沒睡覺，我的皮膚都快乾裂了~

scripts.text: Thudunk!! Babang!! Crash!!
scripts.translation: 咚！砰！撞擊！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Yes.. Just like that
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
是的...就像那樣

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
... ...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
... ...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Argh!! Another convulsing patient.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
啊！！又一個抽搐的病人。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Hey. Aren't you an adventurer? You must be really strong.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
嘿。你是冒險者吧？你一定很強。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Can you suppress that convulsing patient? I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
你能壓制住那個抽搐的病人嗎？拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
You didn't get bit or scratched by the convulsing patient, did you?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
你沒有被那個抽搐的病人咬到或抓傷吧？

scripts.text: Why?
scripts.translation: 為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Hmm~ I don't see any particular wounds.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
嗯~ 我沒看到什麼特別的傷口。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Since I can't figure out the infection route...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
既然我無法查明感染途徑...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
We have to prepare for a possible disaster...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
我們必須為可能發生的災難做好準備...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Anyway, Adventurer~ Assuring and the best!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
總之，冒險者~ 真是可靠又棒！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I haven't been that bewildered by simultaneously convulsing patients before..
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
以前從未遇到過這麼多病人同時抽搐的情況...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Lucky you were here to suppress it with ease.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
幸好你在這裡，輕鬆就壓制住了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I am sorry but can you report this to Fresa on your way? You know who Fresa is?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
抱歉，你能順路向弗蕾莎彙報一下嗎？你知道弗蕾莎是誰吧？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
It is a situation so I am asking you a favor.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
情況緊急，所以想請你幫個忙。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Ee~~ ee~ ek~~~~~~~~~!!

[Nurse Lapplad]
Take those patients down quickly! You're an adventurer!!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
快把這些病人帶下去！你是冒險者啊！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
I am sorry but can you report this to Fresa on your way? This is a favor.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
抱歉，你能順路向弗蕾莎彙報一下嗎？這是拜託你的事。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Lapplad]
Strange? How did you get in here? You should be prohibited access..
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉普拉德]
奇怪？你是怎麼進來的？這裡應該是禁止入內的...

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Hurts.. It hurts..
scripts.translation:
[病人]
好痛...好痛...

scripts.text:
[Patient]
I'm fine. They're making a fuss for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[病人]
我沒事。他們在小題大做。

scripts.text:
[Patient]
I keep feeling sleepy for some reason. Is it because I'm sick?
scripts.translation:
[病人]
不知道為什麼一直犯困。是因為生病了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Patient]
My head feels blank.. Uh? Did you say something?
scripts.translation:
[病人]
腦子一片空白...呃？你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Ugh.. Feels like my whole body is cramped.
scripts.translation:
[病人]
嗚...感覺全身都僵硬了。

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Urk.. I feel sick even though I didn't drink.
scripts.translation:
[病人]
嘔...明明沒喝酒，卻覺得噁心。

scripts.text:
[Patient]
Oh no is there a transfectant found in me..
scripts.translation:
[病人]
糟糕，我體內是不是發現了傳染源...

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
We used to deliver things like daily necessities or research tools here before the accident.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
事故之前，我們曾在這裡運送生活必需品和研究工具。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Work that involved going out to other places a lot more even as a staff member here.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
作為這裡的職員，經常需要去其他地方工作。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
What?! Is something going on? The Mechanicians and Facilities managers look busy.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
什麼？發生什麼事了？機械師和設施管理員看起來很忙。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Yaa~ Did you try the grapes?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
呀~ 你嚐嚐葡萄了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Isn't it great that we can grow fresh grapes in an underground evacuation facility like this?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
能在像這樣的地下避難所裡種出鮮摘葡萄，真是太好了吧？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Some people are suddenly attacking others.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
有些人突然開始攻擊別人。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
What in the hell is going on?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
They were talking about it in the broadcast since yesterday so you know the gist of the situation, right?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
昨天開始廣播裡就在說了，你應該知道大概的情況吧？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
The contaminant is getting to the interior of the air-raid shelter so the decision has been made to move all supplies to the uncontaminated zone Z-2 that the Chemical Substance Specialists found.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
汙染物已經侵入防空洞內部，所以決定將所有物資轉移到化學專家發現的未受汙染區域Z-2。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
There was a request to move the cargo with the Adventurers since the scrawny researchers won't be of help.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
因為那些瘦弱無用的研究員幫不上忙，所以請求由冒險者來運送貨物。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Alright- let's move the cargo to Zone Z-2 first.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
好了——先把貨物運到Z-2區域。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
If you go to the machine Warehouse on your way back there will a person called Al. Tell him
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
回程時去機器倉庫，那裡有個叫阿爾的人。告訴他：

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]

scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
^0000FF你們這群白痴！！別用那些愚蠢的機器浪費材料了！！^000000

scripts.text: Eh?
scripts.translation: 誒？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Don't understand? Tell Al in the machine Warehouse
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
不明白嗎？去機器倉庫告訴阿爾：

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
^0000FFYou idiots!! Stop wasting material with stupid machines!!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
^0000FF你們這群白痴！！別用那些愚蠢的機器浪費材料了！！^000000

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Remember to get every postposition right and convey my feeling 100%.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
記得把每個助詞都用對，百分之百傳達我的情緒。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Transport the cargo to Zone Z-2 first.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
先把貨物運到Z-2區域。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
On your way back go to the machine Warehouse and tell Al
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
回程時去機器倉庫，告訴阿爾：

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
^0000FF You idiots!! Stop wasting material with stupid machines!!^000000?? for me and come back.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
^0000FF你們這群白痴！！別用那些愚蠢的機器浪費材料了！！^000000？？ 替我傳達這句話，然後回來。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Did you deliver the goods to Zone Z-2?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
貨物送到Z-2區域了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Oh! Wasn't there one more thing I requested? Did you send the message to the Mechanicians?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
哦！我是不是還拜託了你另一件事？給機械師傳話了嗎？

scripts.text: Not yet..
scripts.translation: 還沒...

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Ah.. What should I do.. Should I go since most of the goods are moved?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
啊...我該怎麼辦...既然大部分貨物都運完了，我要不要親自去一趟？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
If I leave it like this those idiots who know nothing outside of machines might do something with the precious components...
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
要是就這麼放著不管，那群除了機器什麼都不懂的白痴可能會拿珍貴的零件亂來...

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
What should we do? Should I go? Or do you want to go back?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
該怎麼辦呢？我去？還是你想回去？

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text: Do not go back.
scripts.translation: 不用回去

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Alright. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
好吧。你去吧。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Yeah? I guess the machine Warehouse is kind of far.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
是嗎？看來機器倉庫確實挺遠的。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Since we're almost done here I will finish up quickly and go. This is compensation for the work.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
既然差不多結束了，我就長話短說。這是給你的工作報酬。

scripts.text: - The small round capsule has percolated through skin. It feels like experience has accumulated.
scripts.translation: - 小圓膠囊滲入了皮膚。感覺像是積累了經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Though our survival isn't sure because of the contaminant,
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
雖然因為汙染物的存在，我們的生存狀況並不確定，

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
The chief researcher told us to adequately compensate the adventurers who were caught up in the explosion.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
但首席研究員指示我們要妥善補償那些捲入爆炸事故的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Don't worry about it though.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
不過你不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
You conveyed my feeling right?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
你傳達了我的心意了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
They should be smartened up by now. They wouldn't waste precious components again, right?
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
他們現在應該長記性了吧。不會再浪費珍貴的部件了吧？

scripts.text:
[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Here! This is compensation for the job.
scripts.translation:
[運輸主管 埃農]
給！這是你的工作報酬。

[Transportation Executive Ernon]
Don't worry about it though.
scripts.translation:

不過你不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
It is a relief we were able to evacuate to the air-raid shelter interior in advance.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
幸好我們提前撤離到了防空洞內部。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
If we weren't able to evacuate..? We probably won't be here.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
如果我們沒能撤離...？我們可能就不在這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Is there something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
A while ago the Facilities managers were running around in haste.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
剛才設施管理員們都在匆忙地跑來跑去。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
What in the world?! You ate fresh grapes? Why didn't I get to eat them? Why?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
天哪！你吃了鮮摘葡萄？為什麼我沒吃到？為什麼啊？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
This place is sure quiet. Why you ask?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
這裡確實很安靜。你問為什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Not many people come this far.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
很少有人會走到這麼遠的地方。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Ah! Come on in. It seems there are a lot of visitors today because of the broadcast this morning.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
啊！請進。看來因為早上的廣播，今天有不少訪客。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
You're here because Ernon sent you right?
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
你是埃農派你來的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
I have received the item you have brought.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
我已經收到你帶來的物品了。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
Eh-? Are you taking it back? That is a lot of work.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
誒？你要把它拿回去嗎？那太麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Distribution Chief Avrandi]
You are going through a lot.
scripts.translation:
[配送主管 阿夫蘭迪]
真是辛苦你了。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務 -

scripts.text:
[Dimensional Device]
Do you want finish your travels and
go back to your original time?
^FF0000All traces in this place will be erased if you go back to your original time.^000000
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
你想結束旅程並回到原來的時間嗎？
^FF0000如果你回到原來的時間，這裡的所有痕跡都將被抹去。^000000

scripts.text: Stay here.
scripts.translation: 留在這裡。

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text:
[Dimensional Device]
Your whole body becomes heavy and time seems to be passing faster around you.
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
你的身體變得沉重，周圍的時間似乎流逝得更快了。

scripts.text: A mysteriously intense driving energy can be felt from this device.
scripts.translation: 從這個裝置中，可以感受到一種神秘而強烈的驅動能量。

scripts.text: Ignore
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text: Pull it
scripts.translation: 拉動它

scripts.text: The surrounding distortion of time seems to be returning to normal.
scripts.translation: 周圍的時間扭曲似乎正在恢復正常。

scripts.text: This device's use cannot be figured out.
scripts.translation: 無法弄清楚這個裝置的用途。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
You're conducting a headcount?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
你在進行點名嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I am not sure. Maybe you can ask Al over there?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
我不太確定。也許你可以問問那邊的阿爾？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I mean the air cleaning unit you are moving now.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
我是說你現在正在搬運的那個空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I made that. Isn't it awesome?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
那是我做的。是不是很厲害？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Ah!! You're the adventurer. You could check out the farm.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
啊！！你是冒險者。你可以去看看農場。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Isn't the farm good because it's warm? I made the temperature control device there. Isn't it awesome?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
農場因為溫暖而不錯，對吧？我在那裡安裝了溫控裝置。是不是很厲害？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I am worried of the people suddenly attacking.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
我擔心人們會突然發起攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Since we're already here should I make something like a patient suppression device?
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
既然我們已經在這裡了，我要不要做一個病人鎮靜裝置之類的？

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I don't know why everybody is rejecting a device that can move heavy objects.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
我不明白為什麼大家都拒絕一個可以移動重物的裝置。

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
I should have made one when they were making new air cleaning units..
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
當初他們在製造新的空氣淨化裝置時，我就該做一個的...

scripts.text:
[Mechanician Bukal]
Ugh.. I want to make something.
scripts.translation:
[機械師 布卡爾]
唉...我想做點什麼。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Who is that woman to conduct a headcount as if she's the leader?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
那個女人是誰，竟然像首領一樣進行點名？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
There wouldn't have been an explosion if there was no experiment the first place? Right?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
如果一開始就沒有實驗，就不會有爆炸，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
I think the self-righteous and haggardly Fresa has changed.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
我覺得那個自以為是且憔悴的弗蕾薩變了。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
She's become more warm compared to the past, right?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
比起過去，她變得更溫暖了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Fresa has definitely changed a lot.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
弗蕾薩確實變了很多。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Today she is handing out grapes to people. In the past that would have been unimaginable.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
今天她在給人們發葡萄。這在過去是不可想像的。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Why is that Fresa acting like the leader alone but still hasn't taken measures?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
為什麼弗蕾薩像首領一樣獨自行動，卻還沒有采取任何措施？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
Measures need to taken about the convulsing patients. Are you going to cover this up like in the past?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
必須對抽搐的病人採取措施。難道你們打算像過去那樣掩蓋真相嗎？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
So this is what's happening?
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
原來是這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
I should have known when she tried to half-ass things.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
當她試圖敷衍了事的時候，我就該知道會出事的。

scripts.text:
[Researcher Grum]
I really don't like self-righteous and hypocritical Fresa.
scripts.translation:
[研究員 格魯姆]
我真的很討厭那個自以為是且虛偽的弗蕾薩。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Uh?! You're an adventurer too?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
咦？！你也是冒險者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Ugh.. It seems you are unlucky as well.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
唉...看來你的運氣也不太好。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Don't you think this place is trying to exploit us Adventurers?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
你不覺得這個地方是在利用我們冒險者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
The Cafeteria food is good though.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
不過食堂的飯菜很好吃。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
Grapes were served on the side today.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
今天還配了葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I like grapes. I want to eat more.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我喜歡葡萄。我想再多吃點。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
A friend I made here is confined in the temporary clinic. They found a transfectant or something.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我在這裡交的一個朋友被關在臨時診所裡。他們發現他體內有某種移植體之類的東西。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
To us adventurers a healthy body is an asset.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
對我們冒險者來說，健康的身體就是資產。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I ate a lot of different things from adventuring places.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我在各個冒險地點吃過很多東西。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I think the food here is one of the best.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我覺得這裡的飯菜是最好的之一。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I ate a lot of different things from adventuring places.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我在各個冒險地點吃過很多東西。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Jean]
I think the food here is one of the best.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 讓]
我覺得這裡的飯菜是最好的之一。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Sorry. We aren't ready to distribute food yet.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
抱歉。我們還沒準備好分發食物。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Grab a plate or tray and wait in line.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
拿個盤子或托盤，然後排隊等候。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Oh no what should we do? We ran out of grapes.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
糟糕，我們該怎麼辦？葡萄用完了。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
New grapes should be delivered from the farm soon. Do you want to wait?
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
農場的新葡萄很快就會送到。您想等一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Do you know that's the temporary clinic? You cannot go that way now.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
您知道那是臨時診所嗎？現在不能往那個方向走。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
The passage is blocked because of convulsing patients.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
通道被痙攣的病人堵住了。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
You are working hard.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
您辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Cafeteria Lady]
Grab a plate or tray and wait in line.
scripts.translation:
[食堂阿姨]
拿個盤子或托盤，然後排隊等候。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Ahh.. Why did I travel here..
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
唉...我為什麼要來這裡...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Hey don't think of going out that way. It's going to be dangerous because of the explosion.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
嘿，別想著從那邊出去。因為爆炸，那裡很危險。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Today is strange. Hey do you see the mysterious device over there too?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
今天真奇怪。嘿，你也看到那邊那個神秘裝置了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
I think I said it 30 times today alone but there is no device at the door.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
我今天光說這句話就已經說了30遍了，但門口根本沒有裝置。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
I am itching for an adventure but safety outside isn't confirmed so don't think of going outside.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
我很想出去冒險，但外面的安全狀況尚未確認，所以別想著出去。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
A while I ago I couldn't stop the Chemical Substance Specialists from going outside.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
不久前，我沒能阻止那些化學專家出去。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Seeing how they didn't return, they must be dead, right?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
看他們沒回來，肯定已經死了吧？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
The situation has grown out of control.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
局勢已經失控了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Haa- Should have I stopped those people leaving the air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
唉——我當初應該阻止那些人離開防空洞的。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Breezin]
Today is strange. Hey do you see the mysterious device over there too?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 布里辛]
今天真奇怪。嘿，你也看到那邊那個神秘裝置了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Access Control Guard]
You cannot enter this area because it is under construction.
scripts.translation:
[門禁守衛]
該區域正在施工，禁止進入。

scripts.text:

啊——我告訴過你，假裝睡覺的時候不要在地板上塗鴉。

You ran around the elephant trunk thirty times so you must be sick. Claiming he can't feel dizziness. Quite the bluffer.

你在象鼻上跑了三十圈，肯定生病了。還說自己不頭暈。真是個騙子。

Ah geez! There is no other issues yet but why is he saying he's dizzy?

scripts.text: Ah ah- One two three test- test-
scripts.translation: 啊啊——一二三，測試——測試——

scripts.text: To distinguish survival days in the air-raid shelter, today will be designated Explosion Day 1 after the experiment explosion.
scripts.translation: 為了區分防空洞裡的生存天數，今天被定為實驗爆炸後的爆炎蝙蝠日第1天。

scripts.text: Everybody fell into panic after seeing the outside situation on the monitor after the explosion.
scripts.translation: 爆炸後，大家在監控器上看到外面的情況後都陷入了恐慌。

scripts.text: But chief researcher Dr. Fresa calmly consoled everybody and checked how many survived.
scripts.translation: 但首席研究員弗雷薩博士冷靜地安撫了大家，並確認了倖存者的數量。

scripts.text: The final number of survivors including adventurers seems to be 326.
scripts.translation: 包括冒險者在內，最終的倖存者人數似乎是326人。

scripts.text: The camera showing outside was damaged in the afternoon. It seems we cannot see the situation outside anymore.
scripts.translation: 下午，顯示外部的攝像頭損壞了。看來我們再也看不到外面的情況了。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 2
scripts.translation: 爆炎蝙蝠日第2天

scripts.text: A witch hunt against the director and chief researcher Fresa began.
scripts.translation: 針對總監和首席研究員弗雷薩的獵巫行動開始了。

scripts.text: My opinion is different. The research and experiment was conducted under her direction but this is an accident.
scripts.translation: 我的看法不同。研究和實驗是在她的指導下進行的，但這只是一次事故。

scripts.text: If not Fresa, they would have made somebody else to blame.
scripts.translation: 如果不是弗雷薩，他們也會找別人來背鍋。

scripts.text: But she is handling it in a dignified manner despite concerns.
scripts.translation: 但儘管面臨質疑，她依然以得體的方式處理著一切。

scripts.text: She says problem solving is more important than blame and is checking assignments of survivors before the accident.
scripts.translation: 她說解決問題比追究責任更重要，正在確認事故前倖存者的分工。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 3
scripts.translation: 爆炸第3天

scripts.text: Fresa.. She naturally became the leader of the survivors.
scripts.translation: 弗雷薩...她自然而然地成為了倖存者的首領。

scripts.text: There was no vote of sorts, but nobody is complaining about her being the leader.
scripts.translation: 雖然沒有進行投票，但沒有人對她擔任首領提出異議。

scripts.text: The day before she had a briefing on the situation of the total survivors.
scripts.translation: 前一天，她聽取了關於所有幸存者狀況的簡報。

scripts.text:
20 Bioengineers
16 Mechanicians
27 Facilities managers
10 Chemical Substance Specialists
Other than specialists the assignments of survivors such as cafeteria staff, janitors, gardeners, distribution directors, health professionals, adventurers caught in the accident have been assessed.
scripts.translation:
20名生物工程師
16名機械師
27名設施管理員
10名化學物質專家
此外，還評估了食堂員工、清潔工、園丁、配送總監、醫療專業人員以及捲入事故的冒險者等倖存者的分工。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 4
scripts.translation: 爆炸第4天

scripts.text: Everybody's work has been decided based on Fresa's briefing the day before.
scripts.translation: 根據弗雷薩前一天的簡報，所有人的工作都已確定。

scripts.text: It was decided that researchers including myself know nothing much research and must continue our lives in the air-raid shelter under the guidance of those who have technical skill needed for survival.
scripts.translation: 包括我在內的研究員被告知，我們並不瞭解太多研究，必須在具備生存所需技術技能的人員指導下，繼續在防空洞中生活。

scripts.text: First the Chemical Substance Specialists and Facilities managers started to install Air Contamination Gauge Sensors in the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation: 首先，化學物質專家和設施管理員開始在防空洞內安裝空氣汙染感測器。

scripts.text: After evaluating that oxygen levels were low the Mechanicians have started to assemble Air cleaning units.
scripts.translation: 在評估氧氣含量偏低後，機械師們開始組裝空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text: Lora, a former cafeteria employee was consulted on the important problem of food.
scripts.translation: 前食堂員工洛拉被諮詢了關於食物這一重要問題。

scripts.text: We assessed that about 40 days of survival is possible based on the food in the warehouse and the number of survivors.
scripts.translation: 根據倉庫中的食物數量和倖存者人數，我們評估大約可以維持40天的生存。

scripts.text: This prompted the Bioengineers to cultivate plants that can self-produce.
scripts.translation: 這促使生物工程師們開始種植能夠自我再生的植物。

scripts.text: Other miscellaneous assignments were issued under Fresa's direction.
scripts.translation: 其他雜項任務也在弗雷薩的指揮下發布。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 5
scripts.translation: 爆炸第5天

scripts.text: I don't know the details but the air pollution level outside of the shelter was measured.
scripts.translation: 我不清楚具體細節，但測量了避難所外的空氣汙染水平。

scripts.text: According to the Chemical Substance Specialists the situation is hopeless.
scripts.translation: 根據化學物質專家的說法，情況已無望。

scripts.text: It seems life in the air-raid shelter has to continue longer. Just can quietly keep working..
scripts.translation: 看來必須在防空洞中繼續生活更長時間了。只能安靜地繼續工作...

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 21
scripts.translation: 爆炸第21天

scripts.text: After silently working for several days the Bioengineers have good news.
scripts.translation: 在默默工作了幾天後，生物工程師們帶來了好訊息。

scripts.text: They have succeeded in artificially germinating a plant that can self-produce.
scripts.translation: 他們成功人工培育出了一種能夠自我繁殖的植物。

scripts.text: Fortunately the air-raid shelter has a warehouse spacious enough to grow plants in.
scripts.translation: 幸好防空洞裡的倉庫足夠寬敞，可以用來種植植物。

scripts.text: It seems we can forget about our food problem now.
scripts.translation: 看來我們可以不用擔心食物問題了。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 30
scripts.translation: 爆炸第30天

scripts.text: A small problem has occurred in the air-raid shelter. The air cleaning units made in the beginning are broken.
scripts.translation: 防空洞出現了一點小問題。最初製造的空氣淨化裝置壞了。

scripts.text: Fortunately there will be no problem maintaining oxygen concentration levels thanks to the air cleaning units the Mechanicians made without approval.
scripts.translation: 幸好，多虧了機械師們擅自制造的空氣淨化裝置，氧氣濃度維持不會有問題。

scripts.text: They are too heavy so adventurers were deployed because nobody else is able to move them.
scripts.translation: 它們太重了，除了冒險者沒人搬得動，所以派出了冒險者。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 32
scripts.translation: 爆炸第32天

scripts.text: Today is the first harvest of the grape tree cultivated by the Bioengineers.
scripts.translation: 今天是生物工程師們培育的葡萄樹首次收穫的日子。

scripts.text: Although there was a small problem of the Mechanicians destroying one grape tree
scripts.translation: 雖然發生了機械師毀掉一棵葡萄樹的小插曲

scripts.text: The air-raid shelter residents are throwing a small party to celebrate the successful harvest.
scripts.translation: 防空洞的居民們正在舉辦小型派對慶祝豐收。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 38
scripts.translation: 爆炸第38天

scripts.text: Chemical Substance Specialists and some Adventurers sick of living in the air-raid shelter have left the shelter to measure the air.
scripts.translation: 化學專家和一些受夠了防空洞生活的冒險者離開了避難所，去測量外部空氣。

scripts.text: They have not returned by evening.
scripts.translation: 他們直到傍晚都沒有回來。

scripts.text: Was the freedom of outside better than the life in the dark air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation: 外面的自由比黑暗防空洞裡的生活更吸引人嗎？

scripts.text: After midnight the remaining Chemical Substance Specialists assessed that they were dead and everybody had a brief moment of silence.
scripts.translation: 午夜過後，剩下的化學專家判定他們已經死亡，大家默哀了片刻。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 40
scripts.translation: 爆炸第40天

scripts.text: A dark rumor is going around the shelter.
scripts.translation: 避難所裡流傳著一個黑暗的謠言。

scripts.text: There is a rumor that a contaminant from the outside has invaded the air-raid shelter because of the people who left a while ago.
scripts.translation: 據說因為之前離開的人，外部的汙染物入侵了防空洞。

scripts.text: Is it because of the contaminant? There are patients who suddenly convulse and attack others.
scripts.translation: 是因為汙染物嗎？有些病人突然抽搐並攻擊他人。

scripts.text: Under the leader Fresa's decision, everybody was checked and those found with transfectants were quarantined in the temporary clinic.
scripts.translation: 在首領Fresa的決策下，所有人接受了檢查，發現體內有感染因子的人被隔離到了臨時診所。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 43
scripts.translation: 爆炸第43天

scripts.text: The rumor in the air-raid shelter has come true.
scripts.translation: 防空洞裡的謠言成真了。

scripts.text: The remaining Chemical Substance Specialists have confirmed that the contaminant is eroding into the air-raid shelter
scripts.translation: 剩下的化學專家確認，汙染物正在侵蝕防空洞。

scripts.text: And Fresa and experts have started taking measures.
scripts.translation: Fresa和專家們已經開始採取措施。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Explosion Day 45
scripts.translation: 爆炸第45天

scripts.text: The invading contaminant will not stop.
scripts.translation: 入侵的汙染物不會停止。

scripts.text: It has been decided to move all equipment and necessities to the less contaminated Zone Z-2
scripts.translation: 已決定將所有裝置和必需品轉移到汙染較輕的Z-2區。

scripts.text: And facility managers have started to install a partition in Zone Z-0 to prevent the contaminant from coming in further.
scripts.translation: 設施管理員開始在Z-0區安裝隔板，以防止汙染物進一步侵入。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: The mechanical device thrown on the floor cannot be determined if it is still operable.
scripts.translation: 扔在地板上的機械裝置，無法確定是否還能運作。

scripts.text: There is a Memory Record somebody is recording.
scripts.translation: 有人正在錄製記憶音盤。

scripts.text: Listen.
scripts.translation: 聽。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Oh- Is this a memory record? Does it work? Oh it works. Works! Should I try it since I'm bored?
scripts.translation: 哦——這是記憶音盤嗎？還能用嗎？哦，能用。能用！既然無聊，要不要試試？

scripts.text: My name is Maso an Adventurer traveling the world. Today is 4th day of entering the air-raid shelter? 3rd day? The vibe here is weird and hard to adjust to.
scripts.translation: 我叫Maso，是一名周遊世界的冒險者。今天是進入防空洞的第4天？還是第3天？這裡的氣氛很怪，讓人難以適應。

scripts.text: Verus city has Adventurers amongst its original population but the treatment towards Adventurers is strangely good.
scripts.translation: Verus城的原住民中也有冒險者，但他們對冒險者的態度出奇地好。

scripts.text: The mood is that Adventurers are people caught up in an uncontrollable accident and need to be treated well.
scripts.translation: 大家覺得冒險者只是捲入了一場無法控制的事故，需要被善待。

scripts.text: As an Adventurer who eats and plays as much as he works, I cannot stand the itching for action. Urgh
scripts.translation: 作為一個邊吃邊玩、工作也不少的冒險者，我實在受不了這種坐立不安的感覺。唉。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Is today day 6? Details aren't told to Adventurers so I am not sure but the people of Verus city seem very gloomy.
scripts.translation: 今天是第6天嗎？冒險者不會被告知細節，所以我不確定，但Verus城的人看起來非常沮喪。

scripts.text: The Adventurer's blood is boiling and wanting to explore places but there isn't much to do.
scripts.translation: 冒險者的血液在沸騰，想要去探索，但這裡沒什麼可做的。

scripts.text: I looked around the air-raid shelter but whoever designed it has not one artistic hair on him.
scripts.translation: 我環顧了防空洞，設計它的人大概一點藝術細胞都沒有。

scripts.text: It is no fun to keep looking at the same hallways and same room lay outs.
scripts.translation: 一直看著同樣的走廊和房間佈局，真沒意思。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Is today day 21? The Verus City people look happy to have solved the food problem.
scripts.translation: 今天是第21天嗎？Verus城的人看起來很高興，食物問題解決了。

scripts.text: It is cute to see the mild looking researchers going around cheering and screaming.
scripts.translation: 看著那些平時溫文爾雅的研究員們到處歡呼尖叫，真是可愛極了。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: The 30th night but because it's always dark I don't really know if it's night or day. I just ate supper so it must be night.
scripts.translation: 今天是第30個夜晚，不過這裡總是黑漆漆的，我也分不清是白天還是黑夜。我剛吃完晚飯，所以應該是晚上吧。

scripts.text: Today I moved the really heavy air cleaning units made by the Mechanicians with the other Adventurers.
scripts.translation: 今天我和其他冒險者一起，搬動了機械師們製造的那些非常沉重的空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text: The air-raid shelter is so large that I had no idea where they were but thanks to that I became friends with some of the Adventurers, especially Castle and Blat.
scripts.translation: 防空洞太大了，我完全不知道那些裝置在哪裡。不過多虧了這次搬運，我和幾位冒險者成了朋友，尤其是卡斯爾和布拉特。

scripts.text: By the way the Mechanicians seem to have mental problems. They make a ruckus for not being able to make machines and got dragged out by the guards.
scripts.translation: 順便說一句，機械師們似乎都有點精神問題。他們因為造不出機器而大吵大鬧，最後被衛兵拖了出去。

scripts.text: The Mechanicians are definitely going to cause trouble someday.
scripts.translation: 機械師們遲早會惹出大麻煩的。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Today is day 32 and I worked on the grape harvest.
scripts.translation: 今天是第32天，我參與了葡萄的採收工作。

scripts.text: I ate fresh grapes and since I don't have anything to do anything to do, I'm going to sleep early.
scripts.translation: 我吃了鮮摘葡萄，反正也沒什麼事可做，我就早點睡吧。

scripts.text: Ah.. the grape was good, I want it again. Did they say harvest was possible once every 2 weeks?
scripts.translation: 啊...葡萄很好吃，我還想吃。聽說每兩週就能採收一次？

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Today is the 38th day of being in the shelter and there is a fuss since the morning.
scripts.translation: 今天是進入防空洞的第38天，從早上開始就鬧鬨鬨的。

scripts.text: This morning the recruited Adventurers to join the Chemical Substance Specialists for an investigation outside the air-raid shelter, many volunteered despite the dangers.
scripts.translation: 今天早上，招募的冒險者加入了化學專家小組，前往防空洞外進行調查。儘管危險重重，還是有很多人自願報名。

scripts.text: I am of the belief danger should be avoided but my friends Castle and Blat volunteered.
scripts.translation: 我雖然認為應該避免危險，但我的朋友卡斯爾和布拉特還是自願去了。

scripts.text: Well I understand that they were sick of living in the shelter for a while.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我理解他們大概是在防空洞裡待膩了。

scripts.text: They have not returned past the afternoon. Verus City leader Fresa has concluded that the people who left are dead.
scripts.translation: 他們下午過後就沒有回來。Verus城的首領弗蕾薩斷定，那些出去的人已經死了。

scripts.text: Everybody had a moment of silence at dawn. They were good people so it is sad to part like this.
scripts.translation: 黎明時分，大家默哀了一會兒。他們都是好人，這樣離別實在令人悲傷。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Is it since the morning of the 40th day? There is a mysterious infectious disease going around the shelter.
scripts.translation: 是從第40天早上開始的嗎？防空洞裡流傳著一種神秘的傳染病。

scripts.text: A few people have suddenly attacked those near them and convulsed
scripts.translation: 有些人突然攻擊身邊的人，並且開始抽搐。

scripts.text: And Adventurers have been deployed to suppress the convulsing people because a lot of the weak researchers are wounded.
scripts.translation: 由於許多體弱的研究員受了傷，冒險者被部署去制服那些抽搐的人。

scripts.text: There is a rumor saying a contaminant came in because of the people who went outside the shelter a while go.
scripts.translation: 有傳言說，是因為之前出去的人帶回了汙染物。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Continue listening.
scripts.translation: 繼續收聽

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Lunch during day 44 the air-raid shelter leader Fresa gathered the Adventurers and had a presentation.
scripts.translation: 第44天午餐時，防空洞的首領弗蕾薩召集了冒險者，並做了一次報告。

scripts.text: The rumor has been confirmed true and a safety partition will be built in Zone Z-0
scripts.translation: 傳聞已被證實，將在Z-0區建立安全隔斷。

scripts.text: A decision has been made to move necessities to Zone Z-2 tomorrow and I heard they need the help of Adventurers.
scripts.translation: 已決定明天將必需品轉移至Z-2區，我聽說他們需要冒險者的幫助。

scripts.text: I have to work tomorrow so I am doing to sleep early.
scripts.translation: 我明天要工作，所以打算早點睡。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Listen again.
scripts.translation: 再聽一遍

scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
I don't know what brings you here but please don't touch anything.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
我不知道你為何而來，但請不要碰任何東西。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
I haven't finished checking the stock and it would be annoying if anything went missing.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
我還沒盤點完庫存，如果有什麼東西不見了會很麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
You're an adventurer. You don't have to deliver air cleaners here.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
你是冒險者。你不需要在這裡運送空氣清淨機。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
It's a warehouse anyway. The independent air circulation system is enough.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
反正這是倉庫。獨立的空氣迴圈系統就足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
Aahh- Looking after the warehouse is annoying.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
啊...管理倉庫真煩人。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
There is nobody to rotate my shift
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
沒有人能替我換班。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
Wha- wha- wait stop!!
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
什...什...等等，停下！！

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
You're not here to ambush me right? It's alright if not.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
你不是來埋伏我的吧？如果不是就沒事了。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
Are you here to move items?
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
你是來搬運物品的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Keeper Pik]
The goods in this warehouse should not be today I think? From what I know today we are moving necessities first.
scripts.translation:
[倉庫管理員 皮克]
我想這個倉庫裡的貨物今天不該在這裡吧？據我所知，今天應該先轉移必需品。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hello adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你好，冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I don't know the reason, but Fresa assigned me here.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我不知道原因，但弗蕾薩把我派到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I always wondered why I was assigned here but now I think I know the reason.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我一直想知道為什麼我被派到這裡，現在我想我知道原因了。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
It is to watch if the Mechanicians make useless things.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
是為了監視機械師們是否在做無用的東西。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The Mechanicians occasionally want to make something.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
機械師們偶爾會想製造點什麼。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
My job is to stop them.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我的工作是阻止他們。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I hear patients these days are convulsing and attacking the people around them?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我聽說最近病人們會抽搐並攻擊周圍的人？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The Mechanician constantly convulse saying they want to make something so it's not weird to me.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
機械師們總是抽搐著喊著要製造點什麼，所以對我來說這並不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
The convulsion of Mechanicians are reaching extremes.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
機械師們的抽搐已經到達了極限。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
They are convulsing so much I may need to call back up.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
他們抽搐得太厲害了，我可能需要呼叫增援。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hello adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你好，冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
We are seeing if there are hazardous substances within the air-raid shelter according to emergency protocol.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
根據緊急協議，我們正在檢查防空洞內是否存在危險物質。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
You want to know how many Chemical Substance Specialists there are? Go to Karsten then. Should be here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
你想知道有多少名化學物質專家嗎？去問問卡爾斯滕吧。他應該就在這附近。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
This next room is temporarily being used by the Chemical Substance Specialist.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
下一間房間暫時由化學物質專家使用。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
We tightly hid away dangerous things but don't touch anything just in case.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
我們嚴密地藏起了危險物品，但為了以防萬一，請不要觸碰任何東西。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
Karsten gave me grapes.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
卡爾斯滕給了我一些葡萄。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
How fresh and tasty it was.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
真新鮮，真美味。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
My colleagues left the air-raid shelter to investigate and haven't come back.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
我的同事們離開防空洞去調查，還沒有回來。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
It was concluded they are dead but are they really all dead? I want to see my colleagues.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
結論是他們已經死了，但他們真的全都死了嗎？我想見見我的同事們。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
Good work.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Chemical Substance Specialist Kori]
We are working to find a solution for the contaminant.
scripts.translation:
[化學物質專家 科裡]
我們正在努力尋找解決汙染物的方法。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I found this while looking around the air-raid shelter
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我在防空洞裡四處檢視時發現了這個。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
but there is a lot of this on the wall. What can it be?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
但牆上有很多這種東西。它到底是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I have been investigating this for 30 days already but I do not know what it is.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我已經調查了30天了，但我不知道這是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I am too proud to ask somebody.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我太驕傲了，不好意思問別人。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I have been investigating this for 32 days already but I do not know what it is.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我已經調查了32天了，但我不知道這是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
Ugh what to do.. Should I just ask somebody?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
唉，該怎麼辦...我應該直接問別人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
I have been investigating this for 40 days already.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我已經調查了40天了。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
My pride won't let me quit now.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我的自尊心不允許我現在放棄。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
45 days have passed since I started investigating this unknown thing.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
從我開始調查這個未知事物以來，已經過去了45天。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Bamdaku]
How did I come to investigate this?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 巴姆達庫]
我當初是怎麼開始調查這個的？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Dally]
Darn it!! Frustrating
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 達莉]
該死！！真讓人抓狂

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Dally]
Sister- Run~
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 達莉]
姐姐- 跑~

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Dally]
Brother- Run~
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 達莉]
哥哥- 跑~
